At just 2. 97 mm thick, this tourbillon with extremely refined finishes is one of the slimmest ever designed. The highest point of the A&S8300 calibre is located on the top of the tourbillon carriage, which has also been redesigned and undergone significant changes in relation to its predecessors. It features a variable-inertia balance with inertia blocks to ensure more stable calibration over time. The redesigned tourbillon carriage echoes the leading role John Arnold played in marine exploration during the 18th century. products.name: Ball Watch Company Engineer III Marvelight Chronometer Watch
products.description: Ball Watch Company Engineer III Marvelight Chronometer NM9026C-S6CJ-RD. The Engineer III Marvelight Chronometer reveals a perfectly balanced design promenading elegance while appearing quite sporty at the same time. The RR ("RailRoad") monogram stands out delicately at the end of the seconds hand and subtly recalls BALL's railroad heritage. The Marvelight Chronometer is available in a variety of colors, from the classic black, blue and grey to the modernist green, red and ice blue. The dial has voluntarily been kept as plain as possible, with the attention going directly to the wide gas tubes. Allowing a peerless night reading, the tubes provide superior luminosity that is about 100 times brighter than the conventional luminous. This state-of-the-art Swiss technology consists in encapsulating H3 gas in glass microtubes. Light energy is released when the H3 molecules strike the internal colored surface of the tubes, without requiring recharge from any outside light or energy source. This model is provided with a COSC certified chronometer movement, the automatic caliber BALL RR1103-C. To protect it, a mu-metal anti-magnetic shield has been selected in order to attract and deviate magnetic field lines up to an astonishing intensity of 1,000 Gauss. A screwed-in crown allows a water resistance up to 100 meters and the case is made of 904L stainless steel for higher durability.

products.name: Ball Watch Company Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer Rainbow Watch
products.description: Ball Watch Company Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer DM2280A-P1C-BKR. The next-generation dive watch, the Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer complies with the many requirements imposed by deep-sea diving. This robust and aesthetically functional timepiece delivers remarkable performance with an inner bezel, illuminated by micro gas tubes and a 2-crowns design. This chronometer has a water resistance of 300 meters and runs the BALL RR1101-C caliber, certified by the COSC. To ensure high accuracy in adverse conditions, a mu-metal shield surrounds the caliber allowing an anti-magnetic protection to an intensity of 1,000 Gauss. BALL's patented Amortiser® system absorbs energy created by external shocks. The Diver Chronometer features a bi-directional sapphire internal bezel used to count down dive time and ensure safety. Activated by the crown at 2 o'clock, the internal diving bezel can be operated while completely submerged under water to time the safety stop. This bezel remains visible even in total darkness thanks to the cutting-edge Swiss technology of self-powered micro gas lights. Gas tubes are placed underneath the bezel as well as on the dial and the hands for an absolute luminosity. With a thickness of only 13.5mm, the 42mm stainless steel Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer is available with a black or a blue dial, and either on a stainless steel bracelet or rubber strap. It features hours, minutes, sweep seconds and a magnified date.

products.name: Ball Watch Company Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer Watch
products.description: Ball Watch Company Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer DM2280A-S1C-BKR. The next-generation dive watch, the Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer complies with the many requirements imposed by deep-sea diving. This robust and aesthetically functional timepiece delivers remarkable performance with an inner bezel, illuminated by micro gas tubes and a 2-crowns design. This chronometer has a water resistance of 300 meters and runs the BALL RR1101-C caliber, certified by the COSC. To ensure high accuracy in adverse conditions, a mu-metal shield surrounds the caliber allowing an anti-magnetic protection to an intensity of 1,000 Gauss. BALL's patented Amortiser® system absorbs energy created by external shocks. The Diver Chronometer features a bi-directional sapphire internal bezel used to count down dive time and ensure safety. Activated by the crown at 2 o'clock, the internal diving bezel can be operated while completely submerged under water to time the safety stop. This bezel remains visible even in total darkness thanks to the cutting-edge Swiss technology of self-powered micro gas lights. Gas tubes are placed underneath the bezel as well as on the dial and the hands for an absolute luminosity. With a thickness of only 13.5mm, the 42mm stainless steel Engineer Master II Diver Chronometer is available with a black or a blue dial, and either on a stainless steel bracelet or rubber strap. It features hours, minutes, sweep seconds and a magnified date.

products.name: Ball Watch Company Engineer M Marvelight Watch
products.description: Ball Watch Company Engineer M Marvelight NM9032C-L1CJ-BK. The Engineer M Marvelight is equipped with BALL's first in-house movement and combines a sporty character with a classic watch design, all while enhancing BALL's luminescent technology. The manufacture caliber RRM7309-C achieves 80-hour power reserve by maintaining a 28,800vph high frequency. Every chronometer caliber is rigorously tested by Contrôle Officiel Suisse des Chronomètres for its quality and accuracy. The RRM7309-C is beautifully decorated, employing ribbing, perlage and spiral patterns, The RR logo, representing Official Railroad Standard, on the rotor pays homage to the brand's heritage. The Marvelight introduces a high degree of luminosity thanks to its luminescent micro gas tubes. This state-of-the-art Swiss technology used by the BALL Watch consists in encapsulating H3 gas in glass micro tubes. Light energy is released when the H3 molecules strike the internal colored surface of the tube, without requiring recharge from any outside light or energy source. To reduce this risk of carrying external shocks right down into the caliber, the crown can be screwed-in tight to the case after the watch has been set. This model also features the Amortiser® patented anti-shock system for an even higher accuracy in case of external shocks.

products.name: Ball Watch Company Engineer M Marvelight Watch
products.description: Ball Watch Company Engineer M Marvelight NM2128C-S1C-BE. Well thought through anti magnetic timepieces. Furthermore, a soft iron inner jacket, consisting of a back plate, a ring surrounding the movement and the dial, protects the inner workings of the watch. This special alloy, reinforced by the shape of the case, prevents magnetic fields from penetrating as far as the movement and having an adverse effect on its accuracy.

products.name: Ball Watch Company Roadmaster Marine GMT Limited Edition Watch
products.description: Limited Edition of 1000 Pieces. Ball Watch Company Roadmaster Marine GMT Limited Edition DG3000A-S2C-BK. The Roadmaster Marine GMT features the BALL's GMT quick-set mechanism allowing travelers to easily adjust time zones. Simply by turning and pressing either one of the patented quick-set buttons, the GMT hand can be easily set instead of using the main crown. The button at 8 o'clock moves the GMT hand backward, while the 10 o'clock button moves it forward. Combined with a bi-directional 24-hour bezel and main hands, the Marine GMT allows for three time zones to be tracked simultaneously. In the darkest conditions, time can be read thanks to the self-powered H3 gas tubes carefully mounted onto the dial at each hour marker as well as the main hour hand, minute hand and GMT hand. This cutting-edge Swiss technology consists in encapsulating H3 gas in glass micro tubes. These micro tubes don't require recharge from any external light or energy source. The Marine GMT features the chronometer certified automatic caliber BALL RR1203-C with day/date functions. It is water resistant to 300m/1000ft, anti-magnetic to 4,800A/m and shock resistant to 5,000Gs. Its case is made of titanium fitted with a ceramic bezel while its bracelet combines stainless steel and titanium parts. The movement can be admired thanks to a see-trough case back and the crown screws in for better resistance. This 40mm model has been declined in several harmonious color variations.

products.name: Roadmaster Rescue Chronograph 42mm Limited Edition Mens Watch Black
products.description: A purpose-built tool for critical search and rescue situations, the Roadmaster Rescue Chronograph delivers extreme accuracy, easy readability and high functionality. Engineered with a patented pusher locking system, the chronograph function works in unison with the pulsometer scale to measure heart rate, while two illuminated sub-dial counters track elapsed time. The two chronograph pushers on the flank of the case employ a new patented locking system to eliminate any unintentional manipulation. The pushers are engaged or locked by being turned. The constant operation indicator at 9 o’clock is also a re-engineering of the standard subsidiary seconds with greater visual impact. Atop the robust 41mm titanium-steel case of just 14. 8mm thickness, the steel bezel features a virtually scratchproof ceramic insert. To ensure perfect time reading even in total darkness, self-powered micro gas tubes are not only adorned on the dial and hands, an inset has also been added to the ceramic bezel. The tritium micro gas tubes require no charging and are always ready for action. At the core of the Rescue Chronograph is the automatic caliber BALL RR1402 that is protected by the patented Amortiser® anti-shock system. Going further and deeper, water resistance to 100 meters and a dive bezel enables decisive underwater action.

Exploring the deep sea demands appropriate technical equipment. Fascinating as they are, underwater worlds are not our natural environment. This is why scientists, engineers and artists are always coming up with new ways to dive and discover the secrets of the abyss. From the start, bronze has been closely linked to such technical developments. A durable alloy made of copper and tin, bronze was discovered and used after the Stone Age and before the Iron Age, between the years 3000 and 1000 BCE. In watchmaking, other than a handful of attempts at military watches in the 1930s and 1940s, the materials only really appeared at the end of the 1970s. Over the past fifteen years, it's clear that bronze has been enjoying a veritable golden age in watchmaking. The reason behind its popularity is most likely one of aesthetics over technology. Designed for men and women whose active lives combine a professional mindset with a sporty lifestyle, the Endurance Pro is up to the challenges of a rigorous workout, but fashionable enough for everyday wear. The Endurance Pro features an ultra-light Breitlight case, a robust material 3. 3 times lighter than titanium and 5. 8 times lighter than stainless steel. Non-magnetic, thermally stable and hypoallergenic, Breitlight is highly resistant to scratches, traction and corrosion. It also has a feel that is warmer than metal and slightly textured effect, accentuating the originality of the design. Exclusive to Breitling, the material is 100-percent Swiss-made. In 44mm or 38mm, the Endurance Pro is available to athletes with a multitude of colourful dials and rubber straps all fitting a Breitlight tang-type buckle. The two sizes are respectively powered by Breitling's Caliber 82 and 83, both COSC-Certified Super Quartz chonographs delivering exceptional precision.

products.name: Superocean 42mm UK Edition Mens Watch Grey Rubber
products.description: Performance and style for all your water-based pursuits. Meet the new Superocean Automatic 42, UK Limited Edition. In the 1960's, the new sport of scuba diving was all the rage. For divers, timing was everything, and Breitling set out to give them the most clear-cut dive watch possible by eliminating any feature that didn't support their lifesaving needs underwater. This pared-down watch was named the Superocean Slow Motion. What remained were clean lines, chunky luminescent indexes, squared-off hands and a high-contrast dial ring, all aimed at maximum legibility. Practical, yes. But what people really fell in love with was the look. The new Superocean retraces the Slow Motion's celebrated design codes, while adding modern features, like a scratch-proof ceramic-inlayed bezel and brightly coloured dials. Broad hands and indexes in a rainbow gradient of luminescent Super-Limi Nova allow for easy readability (and extra fun). The watch is water resistant to 300m (1000ft), as well as being shock-, sand- and saltwater-resistant. The bronze version used a special alloy that has excellent resistance to corrosion, yet will still develop a subtle patina over time that makes the watch even more unique. The rubber strap comes with a folding clasp that allows for micro-adjustments of up to 15mm for easy wear over rashies and wetsuits. For safety, the bezel is uni-directional. Best of all, this is no longer strictly a dive watch - surf with it, swim with it, hit the beach bar with it, then

products.name: Superocean Heritage Automatic 36mm Unisex Watch Blue Rubber
products.description: Made to move between the waves and the waterfront. The Superocean Heritage is no ordinary sea watch - it never was. When Breitling first launched it in 1957, it took a different tack from other dive watches of the era. The Ref. 1004 (a sleek time-only piece) and Ref. 807 (the world's first dedicated dive chronograph) weren't just about exploring the underwater world - they were about looking good doing it. The spear-and-arrow hands, ceramic rotating bezel, and naturally sleek proportions made it a favourite of stylish adventurers who lived for the sea and the scene. Today, that philosophy is still at the core of the Superocean Heritage. It's got the soul of the 1950s, but designed for today. The latest Superocean Heritage builds on everything that made the original distinctive- and sharpens it. A ceramic-inlayed bezel adds exceptional scratch resistance, while integrated mesh-metal or mesh-rubber bracelets fit snugly against the case, secured with folding clasps for a clean, watertight finish. A discreet date window at six o'clock, and the original signature hands- arrow for hours, spear for minutes- ensure legibility and balance, above or below the surface.

products.description: Breitling’s ultimate all-purpose sports watch is ready for anything. The Chronomat holds a pivotal place n the brand’s modern history. Introduced for Breitling’s centennial in 1984, at a time when quartz movements dominated, it marked a bold return to mechanically driven watches. It was born from a collaboration with the beloved Italian aerobatic squadron, the Frecce Tricolori. When the team asked for an analog timepiece that could withstand the intensity of a jet cockpit and still look stylish enough to be worn to formal events—Breitling developed the “Chronograph Frecce Tricolori.” It was the blueprint for the Chronomat to follow one year later. The Chronomat Automatic 36 is made to suit a wide range of wrists. It’s powered by the COSC-certified Breitling Caliber 10, a Sellita-based automatic movement with a 42-hour power reserve and a 6 o’clock date. It model features various dial colors and executions with natural mother-of-pearl dials, and both stainless steel or gem-set bezels. It comes with the quintessential fully-integrated Rouleaux bracelet, which features micro adjustments on both sides of the clasp.

products.name: Superocean Heritage Automatic 36mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Made to move between the waves and the waterfront. The Superocean Heritage is no ordinary sea watch - it never was. When Breitling first launched it in 1957, it took a different tack from other dive watches of the era. The Ref. 1004 (a sleek time-only piece) and Ref. 807 (the world's first dedicated dive chronograph) weren't just about exploring the underwater world - they were about looking good doing it. The spear-and-arrow hands, ceramic rotating bezel, and naturally sleek proportions made it a favourite of stylish adventurers who lived for the sea and the scene. Today, that philosophy is still at the core of the Superocean Heritage. It's got the soul of the 1950s, but designed for today. The latest Superocean Heritage builds on everything that made the original distinctive- and sharpens it. A ceramic-inlayed bezel adds exceptional scratch resistance, while integrated mesh-metal or mesh-rubber bracelets fit snugly against the case, secured with folding clasps for a clean, watertight finish. A discreet date window at six o'clock, and the original signature hands- arrow for hours, spear for minutes- ensure legibility and balance, above or below the surface.

products.name: Chronomat GMT Six Nations England Limited Edition 40mm Mens Watch

Each watch features a dial in the signature shade of each nation, textured with alternative matte and horizontal brushed finishes, inspired by the stripes of the rugby field. All casebacks are specially engraved with the name and logo of each team, "Six Nations" and the "ONE OF 250" limitation. With this expanded limited-edition collection, there is now a Chronomat for every rugby fan- uniting all supporters under a shared passion for the game. The Chronomat Six Nations watches are available in the UK and select EU countries.

products.name: Chronomat B31 40mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Breitling’s ultimate all-purpose sports watch is ready for anything. The Chronomat holds a pivotal place in the brand’s modern history. Introduced for Breitling’s centennial in 1984, at a time when quartz movements dominated, it marked a bold return to mechanically driven watches. It was born from a collaboration with the beloved Italian aerobatic squadron, the Frecce Tricolori. When the team asked for an analog timepiece that could withstand the intensity of a jet cockpit and still look stylish enough to be worn to formal events—Breitling developed the “Chronograph Frecce Tricolori.” It was the blueprint for the Chronomat to follow one year later. The Chronomat B31 40 is powered by Breitling’s COSC-certified manufacture caliber B31, unveiled in 2025. With a weekend-surviving 78-hour power reserve and slim dimensions, it’s a time and date timepiece for every occasion. Available in a range of colorful dials, the Chronomat has a fully-integrated signature Rouleaux bracelet with on-the-fly adjustable links on both sides of the clasp. The case is water resistant to 200 m, making it ready for every environment.

products.name: Superocean Heritage B31 Automatic 40mm Mens Watch Black Rubber
products.description: Made to move between the waves and the waterfront. The Superocean Heritage is no ordinary sea watch - it never was. When Breitling first launched it in 1957, it took a different tack from other dive watches of the era. The Ref. 1004 (a sleek time-only piece) and Ref. 807 (the world's first dedicated dive chronograph) weren't just about exploring the underwater world - they were about looking good doing it. The spear-and-arrow hands, ceramic rotating bezel, and naturally sleek proportions made it a favourite of stylish adventurers who lived for the sea and the scene. Today, that philosophy is still at the core of the Superocean Heritage. It's got the soul of the 1950s, but designed for today. The latest Superocean Heritage builds on everything that made the original distinctive- and sharpens it. The collection introduces the B31 automatic movement, Breitling's first exclusive three-hand manufacture caliber. A ceramic-inlayed bezel adds exceptional scratch resistance, while integrated mesh-metal or mesh-rubber bracelets fit snugly against the case, secured with folding clasps for a clean, watertight finish. A discreet date window at six o'clock, and the original signature hands- arrow for hours, spear for minutes- ensure legibility and balance, above or below the surface.

The Ref. 1004 (a sleek time-only piece) and Ref. 807 (the world's first dedicated dive chronograph) weren't just about exploring the underwater world - they were about looking good doing it. The spear-and-arrow hands, ceramic rotating bezel, and naturally sleek proportions made it a favourite of stylish adventurers who lived for the sea and the scene. Today, that philosophy is still at the core of the Superocean Heritage. It's got the soul of the 1950s, but designed for today. The latest Superocean Heritage builds on everything that made the original distinctive- and sharpens it. The collection introduces the B31 automatic movement, Breitling's first exclusive three-hand manufacture caliber. A ceramic-inlayed bezel adds exceptional scratch resistance, while integrated mesh-metal or mesh-rubber bracelets fit snugly against the case, secured with folding clasps for a clean, watertight finish. A discreet date window at six o'clock, and the original signature hands- arrow for hours, spear for minutes- ensure legibility and balance, above or below the surface.

products.name: Classic AVI Chronograph 42 Tribute to Vought F4U Corsair Stainless Steel Watch
products.description: A tribute to the legendary Vought F4U Corsair Presented in a 42mm stainless steel case Classic blue dial with three chronograph sub-dials Driven by the Breitling 23 self-winding mechanical movement A true pilot's watch A TRUE PILOT'S WATCH Breitling's history has long been intertwined with that of flight. In the 1950s, the brand introduced a novel flight instrument - the wearable Ref. 765 AVI. This pioneering pilot's watch provided the foundations for today's Classic AVI collection, inspired by the rugged spirit of early aircraft. The Vought F4U Corsair was a WWII naval aircraft required to make tricky take-offs and landings from carriers and remote landing strips, meaning speed was of the essence. The plane was up to the challenge, becoming the first single-engine fighter to achieve the 400 mph mark, while also providing an exceptional rate of climb. The Classic AVI Tribute to Vought F4U Corsair honours the legendary aircraft. A TRIBUTE TO THE VOUGHT F4U CORSAIR Housed in a 42mm stainless steel case, the classic blue dial is enhanced by three chronograph sub-dials, large, highly legible Arabic numerals, and a red-tipped seconds hand. The knurled bezel provides optimum grip, even in a pilot's gloved hands, while the COSC-certified Breitling Calibre 23 movement delivers incredible precision and a power reserve of 48 hours. A stainless steel bracelet completes the elegant aesthetic.

products.name: Classic AVI Chronograph 42 P-51 Mustang Stainless Steel Watch
products.description: Classic AVI - Breitling's tribute to legendary aircraft Inspired by the spirit of early aircraft and the design of the P-51 Designed to withstand the rigors of a vintage cockpit Black dial framed by a knurled bezel Driven by the COSC-certified Breitling Calibre 23 movement with 48 hours of power reserve AVIATION HERITAGE The Classic AVI is a celebration of aviation history with designs inspired by four legendary aircraft. This P-51 Mustang model honours the P-51, which was built in just 120 days and became a true powerhouse of the aviation world. With low-drag wings and an engine cooling system, the revolutionary aircraft had unprecedented speed and range, while the Merlin engine allowed incredible performance even at high altitudes. A true pilot's watch, the Mustang timepiece offers optimal grip for operation by gloved hands, sizeable numerals that can be spotted with ease, and an additional hand indicating a second time zone. A WATCH FOR ADVENTURERS A chronometer certified by the COSC, this 42mm stainless steel model is presented on co-ordinating steel bracelet. Framed by a knurled bezel, the black dial presents gold hands, highly legible Arabic numerals, a date display, and three chronograph sub-dials. The Breitling Calibre 23 movement provides power and precision to this exceptional timepiece.

products.name: Chronomat Automatic GMT 40mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The Chronomat Automatic GMT 40 is Breitling’s tribute to travel, not only for its dual time zone display, but also because of its easygoing aesthetics. Subtle dial colors, combined with an all-steel case and bracelet, work with any wardrobe. Meanwhile, the tone-on-tone 24-hour scale lets the red GMT hand speak for itself. The Breitling Caliber 32 powers the GMT complication. Its 24-hour scale lets the user track a second time zone and know at a glance whether it’s day or night, while the “onion” crown (a classic Chronomat feature named for its fluted-dome shape) allows for easy adjustments. As an all-purpose sports watch, meant to cross over between Breitling’s air, land and sea universes, the GMT 40 has an impressive 200m water resistance. Known as “a watch for every pursuit,” the Chronomat mission is truer now than ever because of the GMT 40’s practical size and understated style. Sturdy enough for the gym, yet smart enough for black tie: If there’s one watch to travel with, this is it.

products.name: Navitimer Automatic GMT 41mm Mens Watch Black Stainless Steel
products.description: Navitimer - from flight tool to icon Introducing a watchmaking legend to a whole new generation Presented in a 41mm stainless steel case with a matching bracelet Bold black dial framed by a distinct notched bezel Powered by the Breitling Calibre 32 movement with a second time zone AN ICONIC PILOT'S WATCH For 70 years, the Navitimer has been one of the most beloved mechanical chronographs in the world. Refined and elegant, the Navitimer Automatic 41 GMT brings together the historic appeal of a true icon with the sophistication of a contemporary timepiece, introducing the watchmaking legend to a whole new generation. EXPLORE THE WORLD An updated take on a classic timepiece, this model sits confidently in a 41mm stainless steel case, secured with a matching bracelet. Framed by a distinct notched bezel, the bold black dial is equipped with a date display, a red-tipped seconds hand, and a red GMT hand to indicate a second time zone. Powered with precision by the Breitling Calibre 32, a COSC-certified chronometer equipped with a 42-hour power reserve and GMT functionality, this impressive watch is water resistant to 3 bars (30 metres).

products.description: Enhances performance and style Water resistant up to 30 bar (300 metres) Presented in a 42mm bronze case and rubber strap Powered by Breitling 17 calibre movement Chocolate dial with luminescent hands and indexes THE SUPEROCEAN COLLECTION Designed for those seeking optimum underwater performance and contemporary style, the Superocean collection is ready for ever adventure, on land and beneath the waves. The perfect companion for all water-based pursuits, the Superocean models offer water resistance up to 30 bar (300 metres) and luminescent hands and indexes for increased readability. BRONZE BRILLIANCE Presented on a brown rubber strap is a 42mm bronze case which provides shock, sand, and water resistance to 30 bar (300 metres). This Superocean model combines iconic design with modern touches. The black unidirectional bezel frames a chocolate toned dial brought to life by chunky luminescent hour markers, squared hands, and high contrast ring for maximum legibility at sea and underwater. products.name: Classic AVI Chronograph 42 Mosquito Stainless Steel Watch
products.description: Aviator 8- pioneering pilot's watches Easy to read black and red dial Presented in a 42mm stainless steel case and bracelet Powered by Breitling 23 calibre movement Water resistance to 10 bar (100 metres) THE AVIATOR 8 COLLECTION The Aviator 8 collection showcases Breitling's deep rooted aviation history, drawing inspiration from flights gone by and vintage pilot watches. Watches in this collection feature classic aviator design elements such as large, easy to read dials, luminescent hands, and robust cases ready to take flight. REMEMBERING THE PAST Presented in a 42mm stainless steel case, paired with a co-ordinating bracelet, this Aviator 8 pilot's watch has been inspired by the 'Wooden Wonder' aircraft that managed to out perform its metal contemporaries and become one of the fastest planed built between 1940 and 1950. A true pilot's watch, this timepiece features an easy to read black dial with eye catching red details. The dial is further organised by Arabic numerals, three sub dials, and a date display at 6 o'clock alongside a 24 hour dual time zone scale on the inner bezel. This model is powered by the Breitling 23 calibre movement, which provides a 70 hour power reserve, and is water resistant to 10 bar (100 metres).

products.name: Superocean Heritage B31 Automatic 40mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: Made to move between the waves and the waterfront. The Superocean Heritage is no ordinary sea watch - it never was. products.name: Navitimer Automatic UK Edition 36mm Ladies Watch
products.description: Breitling’s icon—for the journey. The Navitimer is one of the most recognizable watches ever made. It’s on collectors’ lists of the greatest watches of all time. What began in 1952 as a tool for pilots has gone on to mean something profound to every single person who has had this timepiece along on their personal journey. Our icon now comes in 36 and 32 mm sizes for women and men who love the look and feel of a smaller diameter watch. While the 36-mm Navitimer features the beaded bezel and iconic circular slide rule that gives the Navitimer its unmistakable appearance, the dazzling 32 mm variation forgoes the slide rule in favor of a simplified dial design suited to its slim diameter. But these showstoppers have so much more to offer than just their trim new sizes. Pops of pastel, mother of pearl, and traceable precious materials combine with subtle refinements to give the timepieces a jewelry-like appeal adding a versatile elegance to the legendary navigational watch that’s ready for wherever the journey takes you.

products.name: Chronomat Automatic 36mm Ladies Watch Mother Of Pearl
products.description: Breitling’s ultimate all-purpose sports watch is ready for anything. The Chronomat holds a pivotal place n the brand’s modern history. Introduced for Breitling’s centennial in 1984, at a time when quartz movements dominated, it marked a bold return to mechanically driven watches. It was born from a collaboration with the beloved Italian aerobatic squadron, the Frecce Tricolori. When the team asked for an analog timepiece that could withstand the intensity of a jet cockpit and still look stylish enough to be worn to formal events—Breitling developed the “Chronograph Frecce Tricolori.” It was the blueprint for the Chronomat to follow one year later. The Chronomat Automatic 36 is made to suit a wide range of wrists. It’s powered by the COSC-certified Breitling Caliber 10, a Sellita-based automatic movement with a 42-hour power reserve and a 6 o’clock date. It model features various dial colors and executions with natural mother-of-pearl dials, and both stainless steel or gem-set bezels. It comes with the quintessential fully-integrated Rouleaux bracelet, which features micro adjustments on both sides of the clasp.

products.name: Avenger Chronograph B01 44mm Mens Watch Black Stainless Steel
products.description: Avenger Chronograph - Supersonic strength Housed in a 44mm stainless steel case with a matching bracelet Bold black dial with silver and red detailing Powered by the Breitling 01 self-winding mechanical movement Equipped with a 70-hour power reserve A MILITARY AESTHETIC For unmatched performance, the Breitling Avenger collection combines precision with a powerful design. Ensuring unrivalled safety and reliability for any airborne adventurer, the Avenger Chronograph 44 models can be easily operated while wearing gloves due to their rugged nature and unique grip pattern finish. BOLD DESIGN AND NEXT-LEVEL FUNCTIONALITY Presented on a stainless steel bracelet with a micro-adjustable folding clasp, this 44mm Avenger model features a stainless steel case with specialised grip patterns for easy operation while wearing gloves. The bold black dial features a date display and sub-dials for 1/4th second, 30 minutes, and 12 hours. Refusing to compromise on performance, this robust timepiece is powered with precision by the Breitling 01 calibre movement and boasts water resistance up to 30 bar (300 metres), as well as 70 hours of power reserve.

products.name: Premier B01 Chronograph 42mm Mens Watch Black Stainless Steel
products.description: Premier – the unmistakable stamp of impeccable taste A functional but undeniably elegant model Presented in a 42mm stainless steel case with a smooth bezel Elegant black dial Driven by the COSC-certified Breitling Manufacture Calibre 01 movement THE UNMISTAKABLE STAMP OF IMPECCABLE TASTE Whilst dreaming of a time after the war in the early 1940s, Willy Breitling designed a chronograph that would be functional but also undeniably elegant and infinitely wearable. The result was the Premier collection – the unmistakable stamp of impeccable taste. Retaining the distinctive characteristics of the vintage Premier models, this modern take on the collection features a smooth fixed bezel, twin-register dial, streamlined rectangular pushers, and applied Arabic numerals. PRECISION, RELIABILITY, AND FUNCTIONALITY Sleek and sophisticated, this charming timepiece is presented in a 42mm stainless steel case, framed by a smooth bezel, and secured with a 7-row metal bracelet. The black dial is distinctly elegant, with two chronograph sub-dials, a date display, and silver-tone Arabic numerals, framed by a tachymeter scale for measuring distance over time. The COSC-certified Breitling Manufacture Calibre 01 movement provides uncompromising reliability and precision.

products.name: Top Time B01 Classic Cars Chevrolet Corvette 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: Top Time – an unconventional collection for an unconventional decade Inspired by the second generation Chevrolet Corvette, the Sting Ray Presented in a robust 41mm stainless steel case Striking red dial featuring the colours and emblem of the Chevrolet from which it draws its inspiration Driven by the Breitling Manufacture Calibre 01 movement for flawless precision LIVE LIFE AT FULL SPEED Launched in the 1960s, a decade of fun and freedom, the Top Time collection was designed around unconventional chronographs that captured the distinct spirit of the era. Today, the brand partners with some of the coolest names in the automotive world to create its Top Time designs. This Chevrolet Corvette model is inspired by the second generation of the iconic vehicle, known as the Sting Ray, which captured the imaginations of car lovers for over 60 years and became the most sought after version of the legendary American vehicle. INSPIRED BY THE CLASSIC CHEVROLET CORVETTE Presented in a robust 41mm stainless steel case, this smart and sporty timepiece makes an instant impact. The striking red dial features the colours and emblem of the Chevrolet from which it draws its inspiration, while the speed measuring tachymeter scale and squared sub-dials offer a nod to the dashboard of the retro vehicle. Under the hood, the Breitling Manufacture Calibre 01 movement ensures flawless precision and offers a 70-hour power reserve. A perforated black leather racing strap completes the look.

products.name: Top Time B01 Deus 41mm Mens Watch Leather
products.description: Top Time - a celebration of freedom and design Co-designed with Australian surf and motorcycle outfitter Deus Ex Machina Black dial featuring the Deus emblem and adage “In benzin veritas” Presented in a 41m stainless steel case with a perforated leather racing strap Driven by the Breitling Manufacture Calibre 01 A RACING CHRONOGRAPH A distinctive celebration of freedom and design, the Top Time collection pays homage to iconic sports cars from the 1960s. Co-designed with Australian surf and motorcycle outfitter, Deus Ex Machina, this Top Time model will appeal to bikers, boarders, and backpackers, looking for the freedom to explore the world in their own way, at their own pace. The dial features the Deus emblem and adage “In benzin veritas”, as well as a speed-measuring tachymeter scale, and contrasting 'squircle' sub-dials to offer a nod to vintage dashboard gauges. EXPLORE THE WORLD IN YOUR OWN WAY, AT YOUR OWN PACE This adrenaline-fuelled model is characterised by its bold black dial with racing-inspired features, three white sub-dials, and the Deus logo. Designed to perform in all conditions, on and off the track, the 41mm stainless steel case is presented on a perforated leather racing strap. Under the hood, the Breitling Manufacture Calibre 01 movement ensures precision and reliability.

products.name: Chronomat 28mm Ladies Watch Black Mother Of Pearl

products.name: Superocean Heritage B31 Automatic 44mm Mens Watch Blue Rubber
products.description: Made to move between the waves and the waterfront. The Superocean Heritage is no ordinary sea watch - it never was. When Breitling first launched it in 1957, it took a different tack from other dive watches of the era. The Ref. 1004 (a sleek time-only piece) and Ref. 807 (the world's first dedicated dive chronograph) weren't just about exploring the underwater world - they were about looking good doing it. The spear-and-arrow hands, ceramic rotating bezel, and naturally sleek proportions made it a favourite of stylish adventurers who lived for the sea and the scene. Today, that philosophy is still at the core of the Superocean Heritage. It's got the soul of the 1950s, but designed for today. The latest Superocean Heritage builds on everything that made the original distinctive- and sharpens it. The collection introduces the B31 automatic movement, Breitling's first exclusive three-hand manufacture caliber. A ceramic-inlayed bezel adds exceptional scratch resistance, while integrated mesh-metal or mesh-rubber bracelets fit snugly against the case, secured with folding clasps for a clean, watertight finish. A discreet date window at six o'clock, and the original signature hands- arrow for hours, spear for minutes- ensure legibility and balance, above or below the surface.

products.name: Super Avenger B01 Chronograph 46 Mens Watch
products.description: Built for jet pilots, the Avenger is designed to take on the toughest cockpits and keep coming back for more. But you don’t need air force credentials to appreciate its bold design, exceptional resilience, and next-level functionality. products.name: Lady Premier 36mm Ladies Watch Green
products.description: Lady Premier reimagines the brand’s 1940s designs for today. Sculptural silhouettes, radiant hues, cascading diamonds, and ombré finishes come together in playful elegance. The collection captures the poise and unscripted spirit of the Lady Premier woman - honoring those who shaped the brand’s past and those defining its future. In the 1940s, Willy Breitling introduced the Premier line, elevating the chronograph from a tool of precision to an expression of style, with refined materials, elegant detailing, and one of the first chronographs designed specifically for women. Later, his stylish and charismatic wife Beatrice would become his muse and a defining force in the brand’s creative direction. Now, Breitling brings that unscripted elegance into the present with the new Lady Premier. Sculptural silhouettes, radiant hues, cascading diamonds, and ombré finishes define its playful yet elevated design language. Minimalist numerals, lozenge hands, and a sculptural crown enhance its jewellery like appeal. The 36 mm automatic models pair rich dials with gradient alligator-leather straps and are powered by the COSC-certified Caliber 10 automatic movement. Lady Premier celebrates women who are effortlessly confident, naturally charming, unapologetically themselves. Whether dining out with friends, chasing big ideas, or taking on the city—she brings ease, elegance, and a touch of fun to everything she does.

It’s powered by the COSC-certified Breitling Caliber 10, a Sellita-based automatic movement with a 42-hour power reserve and a 6 o’clock date. For our 140th anniversary, we introduced the Caliber B19 - Breitling's first exclusive perpetual calendar chronograph movement. The milestone achievement now powers this special-edition Navitimer, a watch with its own legendary history. First created in 1952 for the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association (AOPA), the Navitimer was designed for precision in the cockpit, combining a chronograph with Breitling's patented circular slide rule. Pilots swore by its flight-computer functionality, but its appeal soon extended beyond aviation- to star athletes, musicians, and even astronauts. In 1962, it became the fitst Swiss wristwatch in space. This edition bridges past future: a steel case, platinum bezel, ice-blue dial, and the remarkable B19 movement- an automatic chronograph with a perpetual calendar. A watch built from heritage, made for today.

products.description: Breitling's 140th Anniversary limited-edition trilogy of Navitimer, Premier, and Super Chronomat, all featuring the Manufacture Caliber B19- a perpetual calendar chronograph. Founded in 1884, Breitling is marking its anniversary with a new addition to its roster of pioneering achievements: the Caliber B19, the brand's first perpetual calendar chronograph movement. The new caliber makes its debut in three limited-edition 140th-anniversary pieces representing Breitling's icons: the Premier, Navitimer, and Chronomat. The Premier made its debut in 1943 as the watch that took the chronograph out of the cockpit and into society, making it a symbol- in the words of founder Willy Breilting- of "impeccable taste". The Navitimer was the first watch for pilots to combine a chronograph with the brand's proprietary wrist-worn circular slide rule. Originally developed in 1952 for the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association (AOPA), the Navitimer quickly found favour with a broader audience that included star athletes, musicians, and astronauts- in 1962 it even became the first Swiss wristwatch in space. The Chronomat first launched in 1983 as the official wathc of Italy's areobatics team, the Frecce Tricolori. The popularity of its design led to a wider release a year later. The Chronomat was instrumental in restoring the popularity of mechanical chronographs during an era dominated by quarts watches. products.name: Terra Nova 40.5mm Date Mens Watch Green
products.description: Bremont introduces the Terra Nova field watch collection, referencing and inspired by military pocket watches of the early 20th century. Styled and meticulously crafted, Terra Nova includes all the hallmarks of these original timepieces, capturing their rugged elegance, practicality, simplicity, and essential functionality, reinterpreted for the 21st century. Featuring a contemporary, geometrical cushion case, elevated through the use of 904L stainless steel, and finished with a combination of brushed and polished texturing for a unique and iconic wristwatch. The watch’s dial features oversized numerals cut in full-block Super- Lumi Nova® for increased legibility in low light conditions. The Super-Lumi Nova® application is continued across the indexes on the broken railroad minute track and vintage inspired hands. The closed case back is engraved with a unique design featuring a charted map of the world and the words ‘Terra Nova’.The oversized crown combines functionality and crafted elegance, directly referencing field watches from an era where gloved hands needed to operate the crown with accuracy. It is enhanced through the application of Bremont’s new logo ‘The Wayfinder’, reinforcing the brand’s passion for adventure and exploration.

Featuring a contemporary, geometrical cushion case, elevated through the use of 904L stainless steel, and finished with a combination of brushed and polished texturing for a unique and iconic wristwatch. The watch’s dial features oversized numerals cut in full-block Super-Lumi Nova® for increased legibility in low light conditions. The Super-Lumi Nova® application is continued across the indexes on the broken railroad minute track and vintage inspired hands. The closed case back is engraved with a unique design featuring a charted map of the world and the words ‘Terra Nova’.The oversized crown combines functionality and crafted elegance, directly referencing field watches from an era where gloved hands needed to operate the crown with accuracy. It is enhanced through the application of Bremont’s new logo ‘The Wayfinder’, reinforcing the brand’s passion for adventure and exploration.

products.name: Altitude Date 39mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: The Altitude 39 Date is a refined, ultra-durable take on Bremont’s signature MB format, crafted for everyday versatility. Built around a 39mm Trip-Tick case in ultra-durable 904L stainless steel, it features a black DLC-coated centre barrel and a slimmer silhouette that wears effortlessly on the wrist. Engineered for resilience, it offers the same shock protection and anti-magnetic shielding trusted by military personnel and pilots across the globe. The cockpit-inspired dial is clean and highly legible, with applied Super-Lumi Nova® indexes, and subtle stencilled detailing. The watch retains one of the MB’s most iconic features: the ‘lollipop’ seconds hand counterbalanced by a looped ‘ejection’ pull handle in white and black stripes. Beneath the surface, the BB14, 68-hour power reserve movement is suspended within a flexible rubber mount to absorb shocks and minimise impacts. The Altitude 39 Date has an open case-back, revealing the movement’s fine finishing in gunmetal grey with Geneva Stripes. The open case-back retains the anti-magnetic shielding, which is provided by a soft iron ring around the movement, based on Faraday Cage principles. For the Altitude 39 Date, Bremont introduces a new bracelet design, crafted in brushed 904L stainless steel. Featuring quick-release functionality and engineered for maximum flexibility, it is secured with curved bars that enable smooth articulation and exceptional comfort.

products.name: Terra Nova Jumping Hour 35mm Unisex Watch Stainless Steel Bracelet
products.description: The Terra Nova 35 Jumping Hour brings Bremont’s distinctive montre à guichet display to a new, more compact 35mm case, offering a classic dress watch silhouette with a touch of vintage appeal. Crafted from polished and brushed 904L steel, the cushion-shaped case houses a brushed steel face with dual apertures at 12 and 6 o’clock displaying the hours and minutes, alongside an engraved Bremont Wayfinder logo at its centre. At its heart is the automatic Bremont Calibre BC634, developed exclusively in partnership with Sellita. Its high-torque Jumping Hour complication delivers instantaneous hour changes in less than one-tenth of a second, alongside a 56-hour power reserve. Presented on a polished and brushed 904L steel bracelet.

products.name: Supermarine 500M 43mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: The Supermarine 500m marks a bold new chapter in Bremont’s professional dive watch collection. Crafted in 904L stainless steel, the 43mm case features a slimmer, more ergonomic profile with enhanced crown and bezel guards for added durability. Designed to withstand the pressures of deep-sea diving, it boasts a 500-metre water resistance rating, a helium escape valve, and a textured black ceramic uni-directional bezel. The dial introduces a striking new wave-pattern design, inspired by the ocean’s surface. Applied Super-Lumi Nova® indexes and sword hands ensure exceptional legibility in low light, while a domed sapphire crystal enhances clarity and adds a refined finish. Powered by the automatic BB64 movement with a 56-hour power reserve, the Supermarine 500m offers uncompromising performance beneath the surface. Available on Bremont’s newly engineered quick-release Supermarine bracelet – with micro-adjustment and polished-satin infinity links – or a high-performance rubber or NATO strap, this is a rugged yet refined dive watch made for those who take it further.

products.description: Following the sold-out success of the Terra Nova Jumping Hour Bronze — winner of Trend Watch of the Year 2025 at the Watch Pro UK Awards — our latest Jumping Hour iteration continues the concept in 904L stainless steel. Its 38mm cushion-shaped case, meticulously finished in brushed and polished 904L steel, offers exceptional strength and corrosion resistance while retaining the rugged elegance that defines the Terra Nova collection of field watches. Powered by the exclusive BC634 Jumping Hour calibre, developed in partnership with Sellita, the watch delivers a sharp, instantaneous jump of the hour disc in under a tenth of a second. The clean, montre à guichet dial displays hours and minutes through crisp linear windows, complemented by a compass-inspired sweeping seconds hand that reinforces Bremont’s enduring connection to exploration and navigation. Offered with a matching 904L steel bracelet or a brown nubuck strap with cream box stitching, the Terra Nova Jumping Hour in Steel combines contemporary design, mechanical precision, and understated utility. Compact, distinctive, and engineered for reliability, it stands as a bold continuation of one of Bremont’s most celebrated modern designs.

products.name: Supermarine 300M Date 40mm Mens Watch Brown
products.description: Introducing the Supermarine 300m Date Bi-Colour, featuring a sleek profile case shape crafted in 904L stainless steel and 18ct rose gold. The 18ct rose gold-capped, knurled-edged bezel showcases trapezoid indexes on the uni-directional brown aluminum insert, seamlessly transitioning onto the dial to form a naval-inspired crosshair that draws the eye to the striking brown gradient dial. Enhancing this design is the superior durability of the 904L steel case, an evolution from the previous 316L steel, paired with the clarity of applied indexes and Super-Lumi Nova® for exceptional visibility in low light. Completing the look is the elegant 18ct rose gold-capped screw-in crown. Turning the case over reveals a case back engraved with a map of the world’s oceans, highlighting the purpose-driven design of this practical yet elegant sports watch. Continuing our commitment to innovation, the Supermarine 300m Date Bi-Colour is fitted with our newly designed 904L steel bracelet. Featuring alternating polished and satin-finished infinity-shaped links, it offers exceptional fluidity and versatility. For those seeking alternative styles, the Supermarine 300m Date Bi-Colour can also be paired with a quick-release brown leather strap with cream side stitch, adding its own distinctive character.

The deep green gradient dial delivers contrast and clarity, featuring refined full-block Super-Lumi Nova® numerals for exceptional legibility. With a 56-hour power reserve, this high-performance movement ensures accuracy and endurance for any expedition. This model is available on a khaki green nubuck leather strap, fastened by a PVD bronze-coloured steel pin buckle.

products.description: Built for those who navigate the world without limits, the Altitude MB Meteor Time Zones Bracelet is a sophisticated evolution of Bremont’s iconic MB Meteor. Housed within a lightweight yet highly durable 42mm Grade 2 Titanium Trip-Tick® case and paired with a brushed titanium quick release bracelet, the watch reflects Bremont’s uncompromising approach to modern aviation tool watches. The dark blue knurled central barrel and signature twin-crown Roto-Click internal bezel system reinforce the collection’s technical identity while delivering exceptional practicality in daily wear. Designed for intuitive global timekeeping, the bi-directional rotating dial flange displays 24 international time zones for immediate reference across the world at a glance. At the centre of the dial, a clearly defined 24-hour GMT track with day and night indication allows effortless tracking of a second time zone, while a date aperture at 3 o’clock enhances everyday functionality. Executed in Bremont’s distinctive Air Force Blue, the brushed galvanic metal dial delivers clarity, depth and a bold visual signature. products.name: Supermarine Full Ceramic, Tactical Black
products.description: Bremont introduces the next generation of Supermarine: a 500m Full Ceramic, striking, high-performance timepiece. Extensively tested by Bremont ambassador and extreme environment specialist Aldo Kane, a former Royal Marine, Bremont consistently strives to craft the best tool watches for the most arduous environments. Featuring a mono-block black ceramic case, black ceramic bezel insert, and a knurled detail PVD treated titanium bezel. Crafting a full ceramic case is a meticulous process. Soft ceramic powder is moulded and then sintered at 1, 450°C under extreme pressure, shrinking the case by 23% to achieve perfect hardness. The result? A perfectly sand-blasted, extremely scratch-resistant matte finish ceramic case, built to endure any adventure. The 56-hour power reserve automatic movement sits in a titanium container, secured with a PVD treated titanium case back. With an impressive 500-metre water resistance and a helium escape valve, it's engineered for the depths while maintaining precise performance. The full ceramic case not only enhances durability but also adds a sleek, modern aesthetic, making it a watch that performs as brilliantly as it looks, both above and below the waves. products.description: The Altitude MB Meteor 'Felix the Cat' brings together Bremont's aviation heritage with the unmistakable mischievous spirit of one of the world’s most enduring icons. The stealth black dial features applied numerals and indexes filled with high-grade white Super-Lumi Nova® for maximum clarity, while Felix the Cat appears directly on the dial, cheekily running away with the number 6. Bright yellow accents – inspired by real-world flight safety markings – bring contrast and energy, including the iconic looped ‘ejection’ pull-handle seconds hand, a signature of our MB watches. products.name: Bvlgari Aluminium 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: From the first-generation models launched in 1998, the Bvlgari Aluminium watch has redefined what a luxury sport watch can be. Made from completely unexpected materials, today's iconic timepiece flaunts the same pioneering allure of the original watch, speaking a universal language that goes far beyond gender, age, trends and eras. Simple yet striking, Bvlgari Aluminium keeps approaching the watchmaking world with a boldness and strength that feels refreshing and incredibly modern.

The watch comes with an exclusive box in mahogany wood. products.description: The machinery inside a watch that keeps things ticking is called the movement or a calibre. A synonym of size, the word ‘calibre’, first used as a watchmaking term in 1715, originally referred to the build of a watch movement—the layout, dimensions, shape and size of the wheels, barrels, bridges and so on. Today the word is a substitute for movement, the complete mechanism with the mainspring, escape wheel, bridges, gear train, and other components, including the rotor in automatic watches. Calibres are either mechanical or quartz-based. While the latter are powered mostly by a battery, the former can either be manual winding, or self-would by an oscillating mass or rotor. products.name: Mille Miglia Classic Chronograph 40.5mm, Automatic, Lucent Steel™
products.description: Chopard’s Mille Miglia collection welcomes a new design for the Mille Miglia Classic Chronograph model. Its 40. 5 mm case in Chopard’s exclusive Lucent Steel™, made with a recycling rate of at least 80%, frames a dial inspired by the black and white checkered flag marking the arrival of a motor-race winner. Symbolising the competitive spirit, this dial is called ‘La Gara’, the Italian word for race. It is topped by a superb ‘glass box’ crystal ensuring optimal opening onto the dial and hence maximum legibility. This model beats to the rhythm of a chronograph movement with chronometer-certified precision. Competitive spirit and sense of camaraderie; energy and dynamism; speed and style: such are the attributes epitomising Italy’s celebrated 1000 Miglia Italian classic car race that Chopard has been annually expressing since 1988 through the watches of the Mille Miglia collection.

products.name: Quai Des Bergues NO 25 TER
products.description: The slightly vaulted dial of the No. 33, with the characteristic subdials at 7 and 4: 30 , is back for a repeat performance as a key element of the brand DNA. "It is covered with a silvered sun-brushed dial," says Xavier de Roquemaurel, the CEO of Czapek & Cie and one of the three "guardians" of the company. "It's a unique shape to reproduce perfectly the enamel natural dome and it is produced by dial expert, Metalem." The dial is swept by blued triangular hands that display the time with great clarity as they pass the elongated numerals lacquered in a cool blue. The cases of the No. 25bis have been carefully designed according to a complex algorithm. "You immediately notice how organically the crown is integrated into the middle case and protected bytwo raised sections," de Roquemaurel points out, “it’s a revolution inside another revolution”. And the steel itself is not any ordinary stainless steel. Rather, it is an especially corrosion-resistant stainlesssteel variant provided by the Swiss family-run steel enterprise Montanstahl. The "XO steel” – its composition is still a secret – is tougher to machine, but the additional features makes it a very practical innovation in watchmaking. products.description: The 26th of May 2020, Czapek released the Antarctique Terre Adélie, the very first model of the Antarctique collection, a new range of watches that exudes a feeling of preciousness but could also be worn and admired in everyday life. Now, Czapek & Cie is proud to present its new version: The Passage de Drake. Named after the English explorer Sir Francis Drake, the Drake Passage connects the Atlantic and Pacific oceans between Cape Horn (the southernmost point of South American) and the South Shetland Islands of the Antarctic. The stormy seas and icy conditions make it one of the most challenging places to navigate and sailors say to prepare yourself for an experience somewhere between bad and terrifying!The creation of these timepieces has not only been a technical adventure but a human one. products.description: Czapek's Antarctique Aventurine is a unique combination of elegance and zeitgeist. Like a smoking jacket over everyday pants and vice versa, codes are broken and reconciled to better combine and highlight each other. A unique style that allows the wearer stylistic subtlety and, above all, endless freedom of expression. For a wrist above 16. mm, its contained size of 40. 5mm, and above all its finesse, will be a guarantee of discreet but remarkable presence while combining an indisputable form of power thanks to its rough angles, its flanks open to the movement drum and its contrasting finishes. But let’s talk a bit more about the dressy part: Czapek has a longstanding love affair with aventurine, having harnessed its mysterious beauty for special editions of both Quai de Bergues (‘Midnight in Geneva’ limited edition to celebrate the first Geneva boutique opening, in 2019) and Faubourg de Cracovie (2022). “It’s a material that we love to play with, and it was a logical evolution to use it for the Antarctique – they were made to go together. products.name: Antarctique Mount Erebus Deep Blue Full Rose Gold 5N Limited Edition
products.description: Located on Ross Island in the frozen continent, the mountain from which the new Antarctique takes its name is the southernmost active volcano on Earth and one of the very few constantly active volcanoes in the world. It was named after one of expedition ships that discovered Ross Island in 1841, HMS Erebus – which, in turn was named after a deity in Greek mythology born of Chaos and personifying darkness. A remarkable feature of this volcano is the presence in its lava of gold, which is projected into the atmosphere at an estimated rate of 80 grams per day, dissolved in the escaping volcanic gases and therefore impossible to harvest. The origins of Czapek’s Antarctique line are present in ‘Mount Erebus’ thanks to the lamé dial, a finish originally created for the first iteration of Antarctique, launched in May 2020 – the limited-edition Terre Adélie. Created in collaboration with Metalem, Czapek's long-time manufacturing partner, it is crafted using a special kind of comb that creates an effect like a highly textured satin finish. Complementing the rose gold ‘Mount Erebus’ case, the dial offered in Deep Blue is made with a CVD (chemical vapour deposit) technique.

products.name: Davosa Newton Pilot Rally Chronograph Black Limited Edition Watch
products.description: Limited Edition of 300 Pieces. Davosa Watch Newton Pilot Rally Chronograph Black Limited Edition 161.536.55. True to the maxim of French actor and motorsports fanatic Jean-Paul Belmondo, "A racing driver is a pilot who flies too low", the DAVOSA Newton Pilot Rally Chronograph, limited to 300 pieces, pays tribute to those early heroes of the road who conquered the hazardous racetracks of the time with their courage, skill and a healthy dose of bravado. The design of the automatic chronograph masterfully combines speed and time measurement with the DNA of the classic sport of motor racing. The high-precision Swiss movement ensures absolute reliability.

products.name: Davosa Ternos Professional Chronograph Black Dial Penta Link Watch

products.name: Davosa Ternos Professional Chronograph White Dial Tri Link Watch
products.description: The Ternos Pro Chrono White Dial Tri Link is a serious sports chronograph built for precision and performance. Its 42mm stainless steel case delivers 200 meters of water resistance, while the chronograph function, date display, and tachymeter scale provide complete timing control. SuperLumiNova® BGW9 luminescent hands ensure visibility in any light, white by day, bright blue glow at night. Powered by the refined DAV 3052 movement with approximately 60 hours of power reserve, this watch guarantees exceptional accuracy. The screw-down case back reveals a skeletonized rotor crafted from BEYOND STEEL®, shaped as a stylized compass rose for both aesthetic appeal and superior power transmission. Sporty, masculine, and engineered for those who demand reliability when it matters most.

products.name: Army 42.5mm Mens Watch Beige

products.name: Sub 250T GMT 40mm Mens Watch Orange Stainless Steel
products.description: The SUB 250T GMT marks DOXA’s return to the GMT function, blending dive-watch durability with world-time functionality. Its 40mm stainless steel case ensures a perfect balance of wrist presence and comfort, while the screw-down crown and unidirectional bezel with diving scales provide professional-grade performance. The skeletonized GMT hand allows tracking of a second time zone, making it a practical tool for divers and frequent travelers alike. products.name: Sub 300 Professional 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: In 1967, DOXA launched the revolutionary SUB concept, considered to be the first truly purpose-designed diver’s watch accessible to a broader public. The radical innovations it introduced at the time soon made it the benchmark for professionals, too. Water-resistant to 30 bar, roughly equivalent to a depth of 300 meters, it was the first to feature a unidirectional bezel with a dual scale for depth and dive time to calculate a safe ascent without decompression stops. Most radical of all: the orange dial which greatly improved readability underwater. The SUB 300’s 42. 5 mm case is made from the highest quality 316L stainless steel. The three-hand self-winding movement holds the prestigious COSC Certified Chronometer certification guaranteeing precision, robustness and reliability. It also provides a 38-hour power reserve. The date window is positioned at 3 o'clock. The SUB 300 naturally features the famous unidirectional rotating bezel, a DOXA patent, with the dual indication of dive time in minutes and depth in meters for calculating no-stop decompression dive times. Featuring a screw-down crown, its water-resistance is rated to 300 meters, or approximately 980 feet. As a nod to its heritage, today’s SUB 300 is topped with a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with an anti-reflective treatment. It has the same domed shape as the plexiglass on the 1967 original. products.description: The SUB 200 C-GRAPH II was developed to fulfill the role of a tool watch on these high-risk dives. The SUB 200 C-GRAPH II is also made of the highest quality 316L stainless steel. The mechanical automatic chronograph (28, 800 vph, 4. 0 Hz, 27 jewels) is a Tri-Compax model with three counters for keeping track of dive times and a unidirectional rotating steel bezel with the minute indication highlighted in white Super-Luminova. Beneath the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with anti-reflective treatment, the dial dazzles with a new finish that echoes the collections vintage spirit: a luminous sunburst effect that gives the dial a subtle, distinctive elegance. products.name: 42.5mm Mens Watch
products.description: In 1967, DOXA launched the revolutionary SUB concept, considered to be the first truly purpose-designed diver’s watch accessible to a broader public. The radical innovations it introduced at the time soon made it the benchmark for professionals, too. Water-resistant to 30 bar, roughly equivalent to a depth of 300 meters, it was the first to feature a unidirectional bezel with a dual scale for depth and dive time to calculate a safe ascent without decompression stops. Most radical of all: the orange dial which greatly improved readability underwater.

products.name: SUB 300 Carbon 42.5mm Mens Watch The Watches Of Switzerland Group Exclusive
products.description: SUB 300 Carbon Seafoam Limited Edition. Exclusive to the Watches Of Switzerland Group. Some legends dive deep and never resurface. Others return, transformed. Over fifty years ago, the DOXA SUB 300 made waves as a pioneer in dive watch design. Today, it resurfaces—not just revived, but reimagined. Cloaked in carbon and dressed in a soft Seafoam green, this limited-edition timepiece is a study in contrasts: rugged yet refined, technical yet effortlessly cool. The Seafoam dial is a whisper of nostalgia, exclusive to The Watches of Switzerland Group. It’s a colour that feels like summer on the coast—fresh, unexpected, and quietly bold. Only 100 pieces exist, each engraved and numbered, making this watch not just rare, but personal. Presented in a matching green box, the SUB 300 comes with two straps: a black rubber for the everyday, and a Seafoam NATO for when you want to lean into the vibe. This isn’t just a watch. It’s a tribute to heritage, a leap into modernity, and a celebration of individuality. The SUB 300 Carbon Seafoam is for those who appreciate the story behind the style—and know that true legends never fade. They evolve.

products.name: SUB 300 Beta Sharkhunter 44.5mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: The SUB 300β Sharkhunter – true as ever to the DOXA SUB’s signature technical attributes. β for ‘beta’, for beyond the conventional. Because it’s not just about re-combining colors, materials and textures. Always in touch with the contemporary lifestyle, and aware that diving watches need to adapt to city life, DOXA created a watch with a perfect blend of urban sophistication and contemporary elegance. Starting from the premise that a sports watch should feel right under any circumstance, the SUB 300β Sharkhunter retains all of its original DNA while cultivating a sleeker, more stylish appeal. Here, DOXA ever so slightly reworked the design to achieve a slimmer watch, resulting in a profile of just 11. 95 mm (13. 65 mm for the SUB 300T) as well as a lower bezel height (by 0. 5 mm) compared to the SUB 300T. The result is extravagance with a sense of proportion and a choice of materials that connect the watch to our time. A way of juxtaposing elements that seems to have been waiting beneath the surface all along: the black ceramic case, the matte grained dial with black-on-black markings… and the dazzling contrast with the mission-critical information provided by the hands and indexes, and the functional components of the bezel and crown in 18K 3N gold. The DOXA SUB 300β Sharkhunter comes on a black FKM rubber strap for a particularly comfortable fit.

products.name: Highlife Worldtimer Manufacture 41mm
products.description: What do you get when you combine the latest men’s collection from Frederique Constant with its globe-trotting Manufacture calibre? The answer is the Highlife Worldtimer Manufacture, a future icon. The globe engraved dial that features on this timepiece, with its contemporary 41 mm steel case, is sure to awaken the wanderlust in you. To this end, Frederique Constant has capitalised on the expertise of its Geneva-based manufacture. It’s here, in the birthplace of watchmaking, that the brand’s FC-718 calibre was designed, produced and assembled It is a movement of its time: modern, precise and reliable, not to mention tried and tested. Featuring at the forefront of the Highlife collection is a first and represents a major turning point for Frederique Constant. Tech meets style. The highly contemporary design of the 41 mm steel case and dial with globe engraving is an ode to travel. The FC-718 manufacture calibre is designed for exactly that. The self-winding mechanical movement has a power reserve of 38 hours. It is visible through the case back, water-resistant to 50 metres. Admire the typical Genevan finishes that Frederique Constant is so fond of, perlage and circular Côtes de Genève among them. To celebrate the arrival of this new model, the Manufacture has created not one, not two, but three straps for it – a rarity in watchmaking nowadays. products.name: Flying Officer Automatic 40mm Unisex Watch Orange Dial Fabric
products.description: First introduced in 1939, the Flying Officer was born in an era of growing world travel. Designed as a companion to the earliest intercontinental flights, it allowed pilots to track the time at upcoming refuelling stops via its rotating bezel. Worn by figures like former U. S. President Harry S. Truman, who called it “the most elaborate watch [he] ever saw,” it quickly moved beyond the cockpit, becoming a watch for those navigating a newly connected world. Today, the Flying Officer is reimagined for modern wanderlust with an updated city ring. Its timezones follow modern global gateways and routes of exploration, while its purpose remains unchanged: keeping time across cities and continents. It’s made to go far and stay in sync.

products.name: Multichron Sport Chronograph Automatic 41mm Unisex Watch Blue Dial Leather
products.description: First introduced in 1938, the Multichron collection was built for precision timekeeping across disciplines, from sport to exploration. By 1969, it evolved into the Multichron Pilot, a purpose-driven chronograph designed for long-duration timing and tracking a second timezone. Engineered for demanding conditions and built to endure, it delivers exceptional legibility for at-a-glance clarity in any light. Today, the new Multichron Pilot is reimagined for modern exploration. A go-anywhere, do-anything (a. k.a. GADA) watch, it moves with you through shifting weather, and altitude, while staying true to its original purpose: keeping time across distance.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Yachting Big Eye 38mm Unisex Watch White Dial Rubber
products.description: Born in the 1960s, the Multichron Yachting Big Eye chronograph was made for the rhythm of regatta racing, where every second before the start counts. Its distinctive countdown display brought clarity to the chaos of the pre-start phase, as boats manoeuvre for position in the final minutes before the gun, capturing the precision required at sea. Today, as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary, the Tribute to Yachting Big Eye continues that story. A maritime chronograph designed for life on the water, it blends heritage with function, staying true to its origins: timing the decisive moments before the race begins.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Multichron 38mm Unisex Watch Black Dial Fabric
products.description: The Multichron 45 was originally designed for precise interval timing, used across aviation and racing where clarity was essential. Its balanced dial and functional scales made it a reliable companion, easy to read even in low light. Today, as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary, the Tribute to Multichron 45 reinterprets that approach with a more refined expression. Defined by its deep black dial and compact proportions, it brings a sense of quiet precision to the wrist, designed for clear, considered timekeeping in any setting. Anti-glare by day, luminescent by night, it stays legible through every hour, from early starts to overnight flights.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Silverlight 38mm Unisex Watch Silver Dial Leather
products.description: Inspired by the Multichron Navigator, the Tribute to Silverlight returns as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary. The original featured a distinctive display that offered a way to orient in motion, guiding its wearer toward true north, paired with softly irregular numerals that gave the dial rhythm and character. Today, that spirit returns in a more refined expression. With its silver-toned dial, flowing numerals, and vintage character, the Tribute to Silverlight is made for the modern voyager, guided less by coordinates than by instinct. A chronograph that moves with style from one place to the next.

products.name: Classics B09 Tribute to Yachting Big Eye 38mm Unisex Watch White Dial Rubber
products.description: Born in the 1960s, the Multichron Yachting Big Eye chronograph was made for the rhythm of regatta racing, where every second before the start counts. Its distinctive countdown display brought clarity to the chaos of the pre-start phase, as boats manoeuvre for position in the final minutes before the gun, capturing the precision required at sea. Today, as part of Gallet’s 200th anniversary, the Tribute to Yachting Big Eye continues that story. A maritime chronograph designed for life on the water, it blends heritage with function, staying true to its origins: timing the decisive moments before the race begins.

products.name: Masterlink Blue 38mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Keeping up with the asymmetry, the case and the bracelet of Masterlink are no less impressive. The Masterlink case still features the iconic “smile” at 6 o’clock yet changing on the top and becoming squarer. Therefore, the bracelet links echo the sinuous curve at the bottom while following the geometrical lines on the top. The juxtaposition of different curves and lines, however, contributes to the dynamic and harmonious balance of the watch aesthetics. The timepiece is available with a double-layered and sunburst dial featuring vertical stripes in blue colour. Masterlink, the future legacy: a timepiece that maintains Gerald Charles key values of legacy, versatility and craftsmanship, taking the Maison into the future.

products.name: Maestro 2.0 Meteorite Silver Limited Edition 39mm Watch
products.description: The Maestro 2. 0 Meteorite, the Maison’s first meteorite timepiece to feature a small-seconds indicator, is a 100-piece limited edition crafted in a polished stainless-steel case, powered by the ultra-thin Swiss Manufacture automatic Calibre GCA2011 and water-resistant to 100 metres, distinguished by its striking two-level Muonionalusta meteorite dial that brings a truly cosmic character to the watch. A striking dual-layer construction: a thin slab of meteorite above an aluminum silver baseplate. Radial apertures pierce the dial to expose the charged baseplate beneath, evoking the shockwaves of impact. Roman numerals and indexes appear shifted, tilted, displaced as though physically pushed aside by the force of the blast. The white Velcro strap is a true testament to innovation and craftsmanship. Designed with maximum comfort in mind and crafted in-house in Geneva, the strap is hand-stitched and includes an iron core, ensuring both flexibility and strength. The easy removal system allows customers to effortlessly change the strap, offering a personalized and convenient experience, while maintaining the Maison’s signature quality and attention to detail.

products.name: Maestro 8.0 Squelette 39mm Mens Watch Skeleton
products.description: The Maestro 8. 0 Squelette features some satin-finished and rhodium plated open-worked bridges, some others treated with anthracite NAC. All angles, bevels and apertures are diamond-cut and hand-polished, and the yellowgold wheels are decorated with circular graining, a traditional high-end watchmaking finish. The rehaut features white painted minute markers and hands filled with highly luminous Super-Lumi Nova. The rehaut is retained by a series of nine, star-shaped screws that were designed and developed specifically for Gerald Charles. The black vulcanized rubber strap is decorated with the Maison's signature Clous de Paris motif on the top side, and with Gerald Charles logo tapisserie on the other.

products.description: This automatic watch recalls the design classics of the Seventies: dynamic lines and gentle curves lend this model an unmistakable retro-modern character. products.name: Senator Cosmopolite 44mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The ideal travel companion appears with a fresh, powerful look. Its stainless steel case is perfectly polished/satin-brushed and has a diameter of 44mm. This masterpiece is fitted with a deep blue Louisiana alligator leather strap, a blue or grey synthetic fabric strap, or a stainless steel bracelet with fine adjustment mechanism. Globetrotters wearing the Senator Cosmopolite are optimally equipped for their travels. The central hour and minute hands on the dial show the local time at destination, while the home time is easily read from the auxiliary dial at 12 o'clock. Here, too, are the useful day/night indicator and the cleverly integrated power reserve display. The small seconds, the day/night indicator for the destination time and the signature Panorama Date complete the clear design. Even in daylight, the hour and minute hands appear in high contrast to the galvanic blue dial with its sunray finish. Equally easy to read are the printed white numerals, markings and letterings on the various displays. The timepiece reveals all its charm under difficult lighting conditions: the central hands and hour indexes are inlaid with white Super-Lumi Nova. This watch's time zone ring offers a choice of 35 world time zones. The 24 time zones that diverge from Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) in full hour increments are displayed using a white IATA code. A further eight time zones with 1/2 - hour differences and the remaining time zones with 3/4 hour offsets are represented in light blue IAT
