products.description: This perpetual calendar is presented in a 42mm case made of polished/satin-finished stainless steel. Like all the watches in the Senator Excellence line, this new variant was designed with the highest demands on suitablilty for everyday use, durability and timeless aesthetics. The timepiece is optionally equipped with a blue Louisiana alligator leather strap, a robust blue synthetic strap or a stainless steel bracelet. The perpetual calendar is considered one of the most sophisticated complications in the art of watchmaking. With the Senator Excellence Perpetual Calendar, Glashutte Original gives this tradition-steeped complication a particularly contemporary face. BOLD DETAILS Built for performance, this 39mm slim and comfortable stainless steel case is paired with a co-ordinating bracelet and features a 24-hour bezel. The sporting navy blue dial is enhanced by the bold red GMT hand, while the 24-hour dial ring is split into AM and PM sections for easy visibility. Championing precision (+/- 10 seconds a year), the internal calibre 9F86 quartz movement provides immaculate timekeeping in any time zone and is renowned for being one of the finest quartz calibres in the world. A co-ordinating stainless steel bracelet completes the look. Water resistance up to 20 bar (200 metres) further enhances performance.

products.name: Heritage Elegance 62GS 26mm Ladies Watch Blue
products.description: A new model inspired by the “wind in the spring sunshine” joins the 62GS lineup, evoking a gentle breeze that dazzles the senses when the cherry blossoms are in bloom. The 62GS launched in 1967 with Grand Seiko’s first automatic movement and went on to become one of the brand’s most beloved designs. This new model reinterprets the original 62GS, introducing a dial that expresses the unique seasonal changes of Japan. The dial transports the wearer to a spring day in Japan, when a pleasant breeze causes cherry blossoms to shimmer in the warm sunshine. The bezel-free construction grants the dial an expansive appearance, with the Zaratsu polishing technique creating a striking, multifaceted case design. The movement is the quartz Caliber 4J51, which achieves an accuracy of ±10 seconds per year.

products.name: Heritage Elegance 62GS 26mm Ladies Watch Pink
products.description: A new 26mm quartz model enhances the 62GS lineup with the option of a discreetly elegant size. The original 62GS launched in 1967 and debuted Grand Seiko’s first automatic movement, becoming one of Grand Seiko’s most memorable timepieces. Reinterpreting this timeless design, this model uses a dial that expresses the unique seasonal changes of Japan. It evokes hana-ikada, the beautiful “flower raft” scene in which cherry blossom petals are swept from their branches by spring breezes before settling on river surfaces. As with the original 62GS, a bezel-free construction grants the dial an expansive appearance, with the Zaratsu polishing technique creating a striking, multifaceted case design. Despite the case’s small size, its design ensures perfect legibility. The symmetrically arranged diamonds contribute to the watch’s brilliance, and the movement inside is the quartz Caliber 4J51, which achieves an accuracy of ±10 seconds per year.

products.name: Heritage 37mm Ladies Watch White
products.description: The Heritage Collection- honouring timepieces of the past 37mm titanium case with coordinating bracelet Showcasing the brand's iconic 'snowflake' dial Powered by 4F62 quartz movement Delivering accuracy to ten seconds per year THE HERITAGE COLLECTION Embodying the unique Japanese Grand Seiko aesthetic, the Heritage Collection features a classic watch selection honouring some of the earliest Grand Seiko models. Equipped with the latest movements, manufacturing techniques, and craftsmanship, the collection balances great performance with great designs for which Grand Seiko has always been renowned. THE NATURE OF TIME The 37mm titanium case paired with a coordinating bracelet showcases the brand's iconic white snowflake dial inspired by Japan's Hotaka mountains. Driven by 4F62 quartz movement, this watch operates with accuracy to ten seconds a year. This timepiece is complete with water resistance up to 10 bar (100 metres), a blue steeled seconds hand, and a date display at 3 o'clock.

products.name: Heritage 37mm Mens Watch Ivory
products.description: With a cream-like ivory dial, this Grand Seiko Heritage timepiece is heavily inspired by the Kanro season in early October, when the rice is ready to be harvested before the cold sets in. This piece remains slim at only 11. 7mm, despite its box sapphire glass. It features sharp silver-coloured Dauphine hands, and a black crocodile leather strap which contrasts the complexion of the dial.‘The Nature of Time’ theme features prominently in Grand Seiko watch designs – a Japanese spirituality where each moment is a unique expression unveiled through light and shadow. The watchmakers’ pride in their surroundings is represented from engineering watch movements which emulate the smooth motion of time passing, to creating dials reflecting the beauty of Japanese nature. Functioning on an in-house 9S64 mechanical calibre movement, this can be observed through its exhibition case back. It is accurate to +5/-3 seconds per day and has a power reserve of three days. Every Grand Seiko features signature high standards of precision, durability and legibility, handcrafted in Japan by Takumi artisans.

products.name: Automatic GMT Moondrop 39.5mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: In autumn, when the moon’s light fills the sky with its soft glow, drops of dew gleam in the light ina moment that captures the beauty of the season. The SBGM257 “Moondrop” expresses such a special moment with its textured blue dial. Thanks to its modern geometric spiral pattern, the dial changes in appearance based on the angle of the light, recalling how dew drops gleam in the moonlight. The intricate pattern imparts a refined sense of structure, a fitting complement to the Zaratsu-polished case and the high precision of the Caliber 9S66 GMT movement. Prized for its accuracy, beauty, and reliability, this movement enables the wearer to track two time zones simultaneously. The gold-colored GMT hand can be set to one’s home time or any time zone of one’s choosing. The local hour can be changed in one-hour increments when the crown is extended to the first click position, making time zone adjustments simple and intuitive. The power reserve is approximately three days.

products.name: Automatic GMT Snowdrop 39.5mm Mens Watch White
products.description: As winter’s cold gives way to the warmth of spring, melting snow forms droplets that glisten under bright sunshine. The SBGM255 “Snowdrop” captures the beauty of this richly symbolic seasonal moment. Thanks to its modern geometric spiral pattern, the dial changes in appearance based on the angle of the light, just as melting snow refracts rays of spring sunshine. The intricate pattern imparts a refined sense of structure, a fitting complement to the Zaratsu-polished case and the high precision of the Caliber 9S66 GMT movement. Prized for its accuracy, beauty, and reliability, this movement enables the wearer to track twotime zones simultaneously. The tempered blue GMT hand can be set to one’s home time or any time zone of one’s choosing. The local hour can be changed in one-hour increments when the crown is extended to the first click position, making time zone adjustments simpleand intuitive. The power reserve is approximately three days.

products.name: Heritage 36.5mm Unisex Watch Purple
products.description: In 1967, the 44GS established the unique design philosophy that would come to be known as the Grand Seiko Style, which guides all of the brand’s creations to this day. With the SBGW323, Grand Seiko presents a modernized take on the 44GS. The watch combines the Mt. Iwate dial pattern, a classic in its own right, with a purple color inspired by the kiri, the official flower of Iwate Prefecture. With a 36. 5mm mid-sized case, this 44GS creation is characterized by refinement and elegance.

products.name: Heritage Collection 'Cherry Blossom' Mechanical 62GS 30mm Ladies Watch Grey
products.description: This elegant 30mm wristwatch is a modern interpretation of the celebrated 62GS, Grand Seiko’s first mechanical model to feature automatic winding. It is characterized by its distinctive bezel-free construction, which allows for a seamless integration of the crystal with the case. Like its predecessor, this modern reinterpretation features the characteristic sharp edges and perfectly distortion-free surfaces that only Zaratsu polishing can create, along with a wide dial opening achieved through the bezel-free design. The dial draws inspiration from the tranquil beauty of cherry blossoms softly illuminated under a hazy, moonlit sky. In early spring, the significant temperature shifts between day and night often create a misty or foggy ambiance, diffusing the moonlight into a gentle, blurred glow. This enchanting scene is elegantly captured through a delicately textured pattern and a subtle silver color hue. It is powered by Grand Seiko’s smallest automatic mechanical movement, Caliber 9S27. With a case diameter of 30mm and a thickness of just 10. 5mm, this new creation is the most compact 62GS designs and one of the slimmest automatic Grand Seiko timepieces today. The see-through case back allows wearers to enjoy the beauty of the Caliber 9S27. Caliber 9S27 achieves the perfect balance of exceptional performance and refined slimness. It realizes an accuracy rate of +8 to−3 seconds per day and a power reserve of 50 hours.

products.name: Heritage Collection 37mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: This creation exhibits a new dial pattern while inheriting a classic Grand Seiko case design. The dial evokes a frozen waterfall that one might encounter in the dead of winter on Mount Iwate, the imposing peak visible from the Grand Seiko Studio Shizukuishi, home to Grand Seiko mechanical watchmaking. Such frozen waterfalls are a natural phenomenon, whereby the water flowing down from a waterfall gradually solidifies when the temperature drops below freezing. This fantastic scene is depicted on the dial through the dynamic and detailed pattern, as well as a unique bluish-white color. The movement is the Hi-Beat Caliber 9S85 with 10 beats per second, which grants stable precision by reducing variations in accuracy. The case, which is 37 mm in diameter, is made of Ever-Brilliant Steel, a material that boasts exceptional corrosion resistance.

products.name: 'Dusk Mount Iwate' 44GS Hi-Beat 40mm Mens Watch - Black
products.description: The Heritage Collection- honouring timepieces of the past Presented in a 40mm Ever-Brilliant Steel case with co-ordinating bracelet Driven by 9S85 calibre automatic movement Delivering precision to seconds per day Water resistance up to 10 bar (100 metres) INSPIRED BY NATURE Embodying the unique Japanese Grand Seiko aesthetic, the Heritage Collection features a classic watch selection honouring some of the earliest Grand Seiko models. Equipped with the latest movements, manufacturing techniques, and craftsmanship, the collection balances great performance with great designs for which Grand Seiko has always been renowned. HISTORICAL STYLE RE-IMAGINED FOR THE MODERN ERA The 40mm case and co-ordinating bracelet are reminiscent of the very first 44GS design, but crafted from Ever-Brilliant Steel, this timepiece will remain sharp and shining for longer. Inside, the bold black dial has been inspired by the snowy peaks of Mt. Iwate at dusk, and features a 24-hour hand that allows this watch to tell the time in two places. Behind the dial, the 9S85 calibre automatic movement delivers precision between five and three seconds a day and builds a 55-hour power reserve. Water resistant to 10 bar (100 metres), this Heritage Collection model showcases a see-through sapphire case back.

products.name: Heritage Collection Rikka 40mm Hi-Beat Mens Watch Green
products.description: The deep green dial evokes the sights and sounds of Rikka, the seventh of Japan’s twenty-four sekki or seasons. Spring has passed and the increasing warmth of the sun's rays announces that summer has begun. Japan’s plants take on a deeper green hue and, as they grow, sway elegantly in the early summer wind. This is a modern re-interpretation of the celebrated 62GS from 1967, whose characteristic sharp edges and perfect distortion-free surfaces can only be created through Zaratsu polishing. The watch’s wide dial opening was achieved thanks to a bezel-free construction, lending the 62GS a distinctive appearance on the wrist. Inside is the Hi-Beat Caliber 9S85, hand assembled by the skilled craftsmen and women of the Grand Seiko Studio Shizukuishi. The vibrant green coloring evokes the gentle breeze that passes through the lush grasslands near the studio. The GS logo and the seconds hand provide a pop of gold coloring that harmonizes with the green backdrop of the dial.

products.name: 'Icefall' Hi-Beat 1998 Revival 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: This timepiece echoes the design of the first ever Grand Seiko mechanical 9S watch launched in 1998, with an aesthetic inspired by the surroundings of Grand Seiko Shizukuishi studio where the brand’s mechanical timepieces are handcrafted in house by Takumi artisans. The ‘Icefall’ 40mm case is crafted from High-Intensity Titanium – an alloy that is 30% lighter than stainless steel with the added benefits of increased resistance against corrosion and hypo-allergenicity. High-intensity titanium has a much brighter finish than most other grades of titanium used in the industry, allowing it to be Zaratsu polished to a mirror finish, and it has a higher hardness than that of pure titanium as well. The new dial pattern is in an ice blue colour, inspired by the natural ‘icefall’ phenomenon seen when the natural springs near to Mount Iwate freeze over in winter’s cold air. Throughout history, the abundance of clear water sources throughout Shizukuishi have provided for the local people, and were a key reason for the founding of the watch studio in this beautiful location. This 40mm timepiece is powered by the in-house 9S85 Hi-Beat movement, which is accurate to +5 to –3 seconds a day with a 55-hour power reserve. Every Grand Seiko features signature high standards of precision, durability and legibility, handcrafted in Japan by Takumi artisans.

products.name: 'Dusk Mount Iwate' 44GS Hi-Beat GMT 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Heritage Collection- honouring timepieces of the past Presented in a 40mm Ever Brilliant Steel case with a co-ordinating bracelet Powered by 9S86 calibre automatic movement Delivering accuracy to 5 second per day Water resistant to 10 bar (100 metres) HONOURING THE WATCHES THAT DEFINED GRAND SEIKO STYLE Embodying the unique Japanese Grand Seiko aesthetic, the Heritage Collection features a classic watch selection honouring some of the earliest Grand Seiko models. Equipped with the latest movements, manufacturing techniques, and craftsmanship, the collection balances great performance with great designs for which Grand Seiko has always been renowned. REINVENTED FOR THE MODERN DAY The 40mm Ever Brilliant Steel case houses a black toned dial reminiscent of the Mt. Iwate peak, visible from the Grand Seiko studio. A contrast yellow 24 hour hand further enhances the patterned dial. A modern interpretation of the very first 44GS timepiece design, this watch boasts sharp features, stainless steel alloys- 1. 7 times hight than that of steel used in luxury watches, and 9S85 calibre automatic movement. With a Hi-Beat 36000 mechanical movement and GMT function, this model deliver accuracy to five seconds per day and offers a 55-hour power reserve. Presented on a co-ordinating bracelet, this watch is water resistant to 10 bar (100 metres).

products.name: Elegance 'Omiwatari' Spring Drive 38.5mm Mens Watch
products.description: Elegance Collection- simple, pure, and practical Presented in a 38. 5mm stainless steel case paired with a black crocodile leather strap Driven by 9R31 calibre Spring Drive movement Delivering accuracy to 1 second per day Complete with a 72-hour power reserve UNDERSTATED ARTISTRY Providing you with the perfect companion, no matter the occasion or time of day, the Elegance Collection showcases confident timepieces with subtle beauty that shines. By combining Grand Seiko Japanese aesthetic and refined design, each model in this collection offers elegant timekeeping and style. SIMPLE SOPHISTICATION A splash resistant 38. 5mm stainless steel case protects a blue toned dial- showcasing the frozen water of Lake Suwa in the winter, when according to tradition, God walks over the ice. With visual details and unique textures, this ‘snow-covered’ dial is further enhanced by a blue seconds hand. Driven by 9R31 calibre Spring Drive movement, this timepiece features a Dual Spring Barrel delivering a 72-hour power reserve and precision to one second per day. Presented on a striking black crocodile leather strap, this watch is secured by a three fold clasp with push button release.

products.name: Evolution 9 Spring Drive U.F.A
products.description: The pursuit of high accuracy has been the cornerstone of Grand Seiko’s values since its first watch was created in 1960. In the late 1970s, the development of Spring Drive began with an aim to harmoniously blend the traditional energy of a mainspring with state-of-the-art electronic watchmaking advancements. In 2004, Grand Seiko introduced the Spring Drive Caliber 9R65 with a monthly rate of ±15 seconds. Today, this legacy of accuracy in watchmaking reaches new heights with the announcement of the Spring Drive Caliber 9RB2, which receives the new U. F.A. designation, standing for “Ultra Fine Accuracy.” The groundbreaking movement boasts a level of precision defined not by accuracy in seconds per day, week, or month, but by its accuracy over one year. The automatic U. F.A. movement has an astounding annual rate of ±20 seconds, making it the most accurate wristwatch movement powered by a mainspring today. As of April 2025, based on Grand Seiko’s research. In 2025, the Caliber 9RB2 makes its debut in the Evolution 9 Collection. To the east of the Shinshu Watch Studio lie the Kirigamine Highlands, where frost-covered trees can be observed during harsh winter months. The intricately textured dial captures the beauty of these ice forests thanks to finishing techniques that create pale blue tones that are subtle yet striking in their presence.

products.name: Evolution 9 Spring Drive U.F.A Ushio 300 Diver 40.8mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The ‘Ushio’ Diver features a textured dial design inspired by the richly biodiverse sea around Japan, with its strong currents around the unique shape of the archipelago.‘The Nature of Time’ theme features prominently in Grand Seiko watch designs – a Japanese spirituality in which each moment is a unique expression unveiled through light and shadow. The watchmakers’ pride in their surroundings is represented from engineering watch movements to creating dials reflecting the beauty of Japanese nature. The ‘Evolution 9’ style of this sports timepiece is based around the evolution of the brand’s design principles of creating wearable, legible and desirable timepieces with flat two-dimensional, wide surfaces and distortion-free mirror finishing. Firstly E9 is an “evolution in aesthetics” – the design expresses infinite gradations between light and shadow, achieved with flat Zaratsu polished surfaces combined with hairline finishing. Secondly an “evolution in legibility” – the powerful hands and grooved, prominent markers with Lumi Brite ensure quick and clear visibility. And thirdly an “evolution in comfort” – curved lugs; the crown guard to reduce damage, and the improved crown shape ensures an easier grip. The case and bracelet are made of high-intensity titanium, whilst the bezel is ceramic, providing a lightweight wear with a scratch and corrosion-resistant finish. The high specifications of this 300m diver’s watch are in accordance with the latest international ISO 6425 diver

products.name: Evolution 9 Spring Drive U.F.A Ushio 300 Diver 40.8mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: In 2025, Grand Seiko unveiled the Spring Drive Calibre 9RB2, a groundbreaking movement that received the then-new U. F.A. designation, standing for “Ultra Fine Accuracy.” Boasting an annual accuracy rate of ±20 seconds, Calibre 9RB2 earned the distinction of being the most accurate wristwatch movement powered by a mainspring. This model is powered by Calibre 9RB1, featuring an improved construction that makes it ideal for sport(ing conditions) while sharing the same attributes as the Calibre 9RB2. The term ushio, which means “tide” in Japanese, evokes the waters that surround the Japanese archipelago. The green dial draws from the tranquil beauty of shallow coastal waters near the shore. As of April 2026, based on Grand Seiko’s research.

products.name: Pilot Automatic Le Petit Prince 36mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The Pilot's Watch Automatic 36 Le Petit Prince presents the signature instrument design of IWC’s pilot’s watches in a compact and easy-to-wear case size. With its 36-millimetre stainless steel case, the Pilot’s Watch Automatic 36 Le Petit Prince is designed for those who seek to combine clear functionality with timeless elegance. The deep blue dial with a refined sunburst finish lends this special edition – created in honour of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry’s most celebrated work – remarkable visual depth. Super-Lumi Nova® numerals and indices, as well as gold-plated hands filled with Super-Lumi Nova® ensure easy legibility even in low-light conditions. The charming character of this edition is revealed on the backside: the stainless steel case back is engraved with a finely detailed depiction of the Little Prince. The design is deliberately understated, offering a discreet yet meaningful tribute to the beloved tale. Powering the Pilot’s Watch Automatic 36 Le Petit Prince is the IWC-manufactured 32102 calibre. This automatic movement features a power reserve of 120 hours and stands for reliability, efficiency and long-lasting precision. The watch is fitted with a blue calfskin strap and a stainless steel pin buckle, combining exceptional wearing comfort with a classic aesthetic.

Powered by the 35111 calibre automatic self-winding movement, this robust timepiece is water resistant up to 3 bar (30 meters).

products.name: Pilot Automatic 41 TOP GUN Mojave Desert Mens Watch
products.description: The Pilot’s Watch Automatic 41 TOP GUN Mojave Desert features a meticulously crafted 41-millimeter case made from sand-colored ceramic. The ceramic color “Mojave Desert” is inspired by Navy pilots’ flight suits and the desert landscape around the Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake, home to some of the Navy’s most skilled pilots. Engineering ceramics undergo a complex and highly sophisticated manufacturing process. It begins with powdered raw materials, which are shaped into a pre-form known as “green body” and then machined closer to the final geometry. The next step involves sintering the case at high temperatures in a kiln. During this heat process, ceramic obtains its unique properties like its extreme hardness and scratch-resistance. The distinctive earthy khaki hue is achieved by blending zirconium oxide with other metallic oxides in a precisely defined mixing ratio. The subdued brown dial features a minute scale and numerals in a muted tone, all coated with Super-Lumi Nova® to ensure perfect legibility in low light conditions. The Pilot’s Watch Automatic 41 TOP GUN Mojave Desert is powered by the IWC-manufactured 32112 calibre, a robust and precise automatic movement with a power reserve of 120 hours. It is fitted with a beige rubber strap with a textile inlay and a titanium pin buckle. The case back is crafted from titanium and features an engraving of the iconic “TOP GUN” logo.

IWC’s legendary perpetual calendar was originally engineered during the 1980s by the brand’s former head-watchmaker, Kurt Klaus. The ingenious mechanism is mechanically programmed to recognize the different lengths of the months as well as the leap years. It will run without any adjustments until the year 2100. The calendar information is displayed in three subdials at 3, 6, and 9 o’clock. Made of solid gold, the moon phase indication shows the moon against the backdrop of a star-studded night sky. Through the transparent sapphire glass back, one can catch a glimpse of the IWC-manufactured 82650 calibre. Engineered with a focus on robustness and precision, this high-end automatic movement features IWC’s Pellaton winding system, which has been reinforced with ceramic components and builds up a power reserve of 60 hours. products.description: When launching the new Epic X collection in 2016, Jacob & Co. ventured into a new direction, with new shapes, new material and a new frame of mind. Epic X Bridges is the combination of a staple of watchmaking, the skeleton watch, and the radical design approach of Jacob & Co. As a result, Epic X Bridges unites the inside and the outside, the movement and the 44-mm case. Epic X Bridges' bezel is smooth and polished, with a steeper angle. Transparency, color, innovation, three of Jacob & Co.'s design guidelines are gathered in Epic X Bridges.

products.name: Ultra-Chron Classic 40mm Mens Watch Silver Alligator
products.description: In 1968, LONGINES launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, LONGINES had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1910, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, LONGINES developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive LONGINES calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

products.name: Legend Diver 59 42mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: Originally designed for underwater exploration, the Longines Legend Diver is equally at home on land or underwater. With its timeless design and cutting-edge performance, it has been a true icon of watchmaking since 1959. At first glance, it is distinctive because of its two crowns and internal rotating bezel. Invented by Longines, the position of the bezel inside the case protects it from accidental manipulation and shocks that could alter its settings. These true tool watches are powered by exclusive Longines calibres equipped with a silicon balance-spring. The collection is available in a range of sizes, materials and colours. Automatic watch, 42. 00 mm, stainless steel, L3. 795. 4.59. 9Self-winding mechanical movement beating at 25'200 vibrations per hour, with a monocrystalline silicon balance-spring power reserve up to 72 hours. Internal turning diving flange screw-in crown, water-resistant to 30 bar, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, with several layers of anti-reflective coating on both sides. Black grained dial, swiss super-luminova®.Stainless steel bracelet, with double security folding clasp with micro adjustment system.

products.name: Spirit Flyback 42mm Stainless Steel Blue Sunray Dial
products.description: Longines Spirit - represents the brand’s history and technological innovations Boasts a modern day aesthetic Sitting confidently in a 42mm stainless steel case on a stainless steel bracelet Blue dial with satin, matt, polished and engraved details Powered by the automatic calibre L791 movement with a 68-hour power reserve ELEGANCE REDEFINED Combining both Longines’ history and technological innovations, the Spirit collection is a testimony to the pioneering spirit that has forever inspired the winged hourglass brand. Balancing modern-day aesthetics and requirements with subtle references to a rich aviation past, the Spirit models breathe new life into an already fascinating heritage. EXCEPTIONAL STYLE Secured with an interchangeable stainless steel bracelet, this confident 42mm timepiece is presented in a stainless steel case and features an intricate blue sunray dial with a bi-directional bezel, further enhanced with a sleek blue ceramic insert and striking luminescent markers. Certified by COSC, this chronometer is powered by the L791 automatic movement and benefits from a 68 hour power reserve. The transparent case back reveals the movement at work, including a personalised weight, engraved with the Longines Spirit collection globe.

products.name: Spirit Pilot Flyback Chronograph 39.5mm Mens Watch Leather Black
products.description: At the heart of the Spirit collection stands the Longines Spirit Pilot Flyback, a testament to the brand’s pioneering role in flyback chronograph development. This sophisticated timepiece celebrates a technology Longines invented in the early 1930s, when the brand produced the first flyback chronograph watches before filing its groundbreaking patent in 1935. The new Spirit Pilot Flyback presents reimagined dimensions within a refined 39. 5-mm stainless steel case, measuring just 13. 4 mm thick for a sleeker, more comfortable profile. The bidirectional rotating bezel benefits from an improved rotating system and introduces a countdown timer for the first time, while the box-shaped sapphire crystal and matt black dial create the distinctive aesthetic of vintage aviation instruments. Gold-coloured hands and applied numerals treated with Super-Lumi Nova® ensure exceptional visibility, while honouring the functional requirements that made pilot watches essential cockpit tools.

products.name: Spirit Pilot Flyback 39.5mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: The LONGINES Spirit Pilot Flyback collection captures the brand’s persistent drive for innovation. This chronograph, with its flyback function, highlights LONGINES’ pioneering expertise in this field. The winged hourglass brand introduced its first flyback-equipped model in the early 1930s and secured a patent for the technology on June 16, 1936, marking a world-first achievement. Designed as a groundbreaking tool for pilots, the flyback complication makes it possible to time successive flight stages, greatly enhancing navigational efficiency. The precision of the LONGINES Spirit Pilot Flyback is powered by an exclusive Longines calibre, fitted with a silicon balance spring and resistant to magnetic fields. This hand-wound mechanical movement is officially certified as a chronometer by the COSC. Manual winding watch, 39. 50 mm, Stainless steel and ceramic bezel, L3. 721. 4.93. 9Chronograph, flyback, mechanical movement with manual winding beating at 28'800 vibrations per hour, with a power reserve of approximately 68 hours. Bi-directional rotating bezel, water-resistant to 10 bar, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, with several layers of anti-reflective coating on both sides. Blue matt dial, swiss Super-Lumi Nova®.Rubber strap bracelet, with buckle.

products.name: Ultra-Chron 43mm Mens Watch
products.description: In 1968, LONGINES launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, LONGINES had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1914, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, LONGINES developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive LONGINES calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde 39mm Unisex Watch Blue

In a new 39 mm steel case. Midnight blue marks the return of a great classic. A colour that has become the long-standing travelling companion of prestige watchmaking, which is obviously part of the long history of Louis Erard, and which now returns to the heart of the collection, on a dark blue grained calf leather strap with tone-on-tone attachment points, and its blue grained calf leather lining, now a classic of the House.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde 39mm Unisex Watch Purple
products.description: Louis Erard extends the range of one of the flagship models of its Excellence collection, the Petite Seconde, with three colours inspired by the codes of contemporary high-end watchmaking: midnight blue, purple and ice blue. In a new 39 mm steel case. The colour purple is a subtle reminder that contemporary watchmaking, even if it remains centred on its values of durability, is also made up of trends and sometimes allows itself to go beyond its normal codes. Purple, enhanced by the contrast of polished hands and indexes, embodies this ability to reinvent oneself. This colour came from the top of the range; Louis Erard makes it accessible. The watch is finished with a purple grained calf leather strap with tone-on-tone attachment points and blue grained calf leather lining.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde 39mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Louis Erard extends the range of one of the flagship models of its Excellence collection, the Petite Seconde, with three colours inspired by the codes of contemporary high-end watchmaking: midnight blue, purple and ice blue. In a new 39 mm steel case. Ice blue has become a rallying point for high-end and even very high-end watches. A flashy colour to which Louis Erard adds its touch of harmony, with a hint of colour on the dark blue and polished hands, an ice blue grained calf leather strap with dark blue attachment points and its lining in blue grained calf leather. Here again, Louis Erard takes up the challenge of proving that the codes of luxury should not remain perched on unaffordable segments.

products.name: Excellence Petite Seconde Guilloché 42mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: The Excellence Petite Seconde Guilloché features a four-part dial. The center catches the eye with its radiant draped pattern, a light trap where the flatness of the dial deepens into evolving waves, growing from the center. A classic effect of flinqué guilloché – traditionally practised manually on a rose engine. This central panel is encircled, a classic transition that leads to the large hour circle, covered with a panier motif, finely staggered like scales. A new hoop closes the design, followed by a minute “rail track”. The small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock displays the same guilloché patterns in darker tones. The visual impact of guillochage is further accentuated by the two-tone anthracite combination within a 42mm case. Remaining true to Louis Erard’s ethos, every detail is meticulously crafted, from the signature fir tree hands to the monogrammed crown and Sellita calibre movement. And with its affordable price point, it stands in stark contrast to other manufacturers in this category, making it an accessible luxury timepiece.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Seconde/Seconde/ Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Silver
products.description: Once again, Louis Erard is putting its iconic regulator to the test of free collaboration with an independent creator, seconde/seconde/. And this time, a taboo has been lifted in the world of fine watchmaking: the internet takes its place at the heart of the mechanism, with the dreaded “404 Error” reinterpreted as a minute hand. And Louis Erard has the courage to say so: human beings wouldn’t be complete without a good dose of humour and self-mockery. From Louis Erard to Louis Error. 404 Error: just like faulty addressing in computing, there’s an error in the fitting - this hour does not exist. 404 Error: except that this hand returns to cross the dial with a blue line each time the minute strikes quarter to the hour.

products.name: La Petite Seconde Metrapolis Louis Erard X Horophile 39mm Limited Edition Mens Watch Salmon
products.description: When Louis Erard meets an insider with a passion for fine independent watchmaking, they don't just talk, they create. The result is a new collection base for Louis Erard's 39mm Petite Seconde: three variations (slate, salmon, tobacco) on a New-York inspired Art Deco style revisted in a resolutely contemporary spirit. This Metropolis watch is based on the Louis Erard Petite Seconde, classic in its 39mm steel case, with its "LE" signature crown - the only place where the brand logo appears, Everything else is new, built like a journey between two times, between two centuries, between the Roarding 20s and our own 20s. The result is the invention of a new style: neo-deco, a concatenation of Art deco and the contemporary spirit.

products.name: Excellence Régulateur Lapis-Lazuli Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: The Excellence Régulateur Lapis-Lazuli is the deep azure of early dawn, the blue hour suspended between night and the new day. A flash of Yves Klein blue on the wrist. And as if we needed reminding, lapis lazuli is a cerulean blue metamorphic rock dotted with silicate inclusions. A stone of inner peace. An ornamental stone that has survived millennia, and from which man has long extracted an ultramarine blue pigment more precious than gold. Once again, Louis Erard is going off the beaten track by combining contemporary design and high-end watchmaking expertise in fine stone dials, geological time and mechanical precision, the visible signs of luxury and accessible fine watchmaking.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Atelier Oï Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: For this new collaboration, Louis Erard turns to architecture and design with atelier oï, a regional company that has been shining internationally for 30 years, and a radiant watch, too. atelier oï proceeded in a basic way: “To radiate from the centre outwards.” Taking care to reduce the technical vocabulary as much as possible, reminiscent of the shape of a sundial. The result is a surface engraved with asymmetrical rays, the light of which reveals reflections and contrasts – echoing the passion of the members of atelier oï for the material and the play of light. The art of engraving being expressed here in its essence: drawn lines. These lines create a space, to which the hands add the dimension of time.

products.name: Métiers d'art Émail Grand Feu II Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch White
products.description: Louis Erard continues its odyssey at the heart of métiers d’art with Grand Feu enamel. A new interpretation of this exclusive craft already explored in 2021, which returns in a contemporary classic with subtlety. Every colour you see on a watch requires processing in a kiln at more than 800°C. The artisan’s dexterity changes nothing: you cannot play with fire with impunity and, despite an expert touch, the high level of waste is irreducible. When everything goes well, the result is total. The quality of a Grand Feu enamel dial is unsurpassable. Due to the complexity of the craft, artisans can only produce up to 15 dials/month.

products.name: Métiers d'art Guilloché Main II Limited Edition 42mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: Louis Erard continues to reinvent traditional métiers d’art with this second hand guilloché dial. Guilloché is no longer a question of decoration; it’s a subject in and of itself: a large diamond, an ace of diamonds, with a kinetic feel. It’s no longer a question of revisiting an old aesthetic, but of putting the technique at the service of a contemporary composition. The guilloché required all the dexterity of the guillocheuse: the artisan produces the 99 dials piece by piece, each one taking several hours of work on the manual guilloché rose engine lathe. Not to mention the engineers, who had to invent and manufacture new cams to achieve this unprecedented result.

products.name: Le Chronographe Monopoussoir x Massena Lab Limited Edition 43mm Unisex Watch Silver

An air of the 19th century. A concentration of classic codes in a resolutely contemporary model equipped with a 21st-century monopusher chronograph calibre.

products.name: Le Régulateur x Alain Silberstein Limited Edition 40mm Unisex Watch Green

A tourbillon coupled with a regulator display. An exclusive tourbillon (78 pieces, in a triptych, with La Semaine Louis Erard x Alain Silberstein and Le Régulateur Louis Erard x Alain Silberstein). An affordable tourbillon. A contemporary tourbillon: khaki-coloured, sporty, chic, contemporary.

products.name: Maurice Lacroix Aikon 10th Anniversary Automatic Watch
products.description: Maurice Lacroix AIKON 10th Anniversary Automatic Chronograph Celebrating a decade of the modern AIKON, the Maurice Lacroix AIKON 10th Anniversary Automatic Chronograph combines the collection's iconic design with refined proportions, contemporary detailing, and Swiss watchmaking expertise. Staying true to the distinctive character that has defined the AIKON since 2016, this anniversary edition delivers a confident balance of sporty elegance and mechanical precision. The 42mm stainless steel case features the collection's signature six-claw bezel, complemented by a sophisticated combination of polished and satin-brushed finishes. With a slimmer profile and elegantly curved case back, the redesigned case offers enhanced comfort and a more refined presence on the wrist. A protective crown guard completes the streamlined silhouette. The dial showcases an intricate Clous de Paris pattern, creating a striking three-dimensional texture that captures and reflects the light. Signature AIKON hands and hour markers ensure excellent legibility, while the chronograph sub-dials display elapsed hours, minutes, and running seconds. A discreet day and date display at 3 o'clock adds everyday practicality without compromising the dial's balanced aesthetic. Rectangular chronograph pushers, inspired by the earliest AIKON Chronograph models, introduce a distinctive design detail while providing intuitive operation. products.description: In 1906, Hamburg, Alfred Nehemias and August Eberstein understood that with the turn of the century, a desire for innovation and ingenuity had started to snowball in modern society. Having realised this, Nehemias and Eberstein decided to produce Simplicissimus Pens, Latin for Simple Pens. A design which saw the ink-well incorporated into the main body of fountain pens. Shortly after this, new partners Claus Johannes, Christian Lausen, and Wilhelm Dziambor took over and drove the business to international success. In 1909, the Rouge et Noir was released, which included the name Montblanc. In 1910 the name was registered as the companies trademark. Presenting this Mens Montblanc timepiece from the Star collection. Showcasing a stunning 43mm Stainless Steel case with scratch-resistant Sapphire crystal glass and a charming ivory dial with Roman numeral hour markers. Other features include an alligator strap with a secure deployment clasp and a powerful Automatic movement. Water resistant up to 50 metres.

products.name: Star Legacy Chronograph Day & Date 43mm
products.description: The Montblanc Star Legacy product line takes its inspiration from Minerva’s heritage and the company’s pocket watches that were made during the late 19th century and early 20th century. The Montblanc Star Legacy Chronograph Day & Date offers useful complications and provides classical watchmaking along with a stylish, yet casual look. It comes in a 43 mm stainless steel case and features an ivory-coloured dial with 18 K rose gold-coated Roman numerals, indexes and luminescent hands for the time functions and blued hands for the chronograph readings. The timepiece is equipped with the MB 25. 07 chronograph movement that indicates the elapsed seconds via a central chronograph seconds hand, the elapsed minutes in a 30-minute counter, and the elapsed hours in a 12-hour counter. The day and date displays can be found in apertures at three o’clock. The Montblanc Star Legacy Chronograph Day & Date is completed with a stainless steel 3 links bracelet that has been partly polished and partly satin-finished.

products.name: 1858 Monopusher Chrono 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The collected knowledge of centuries, decades of experience, years of development and hundreds of hours of dedicated labour all culminate in the coming to life of a Montblanc timepiece. To create masterpieces of utmost precision and immaculate perfection, the watchmakers at the Montblanc Manufactures in Villeret and Le Locle put their pride, passion and soul into each timepiece.

products.name: 1858 Automatic Chronograph 0 Oxygen The 8000 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: Paying tribute to the world’s highest peaks and the alpinists who dare to climb them enduring extreme conditions, the Montblanc 1858 Automatic Chronograph 0 Oxygen The 8000 is housed in a 42mm stainless steel case totally devoid of oxygen. This has several advantages for explorers by eliminating fogging and preventing oxidization, thus allowing the movement to last far longer with greater precision. The timepiece is powered by the MB 25. 13 automatic chronograph and features a fluted bi-directional black ceramic bezel with luminescent cardinal points; a dark grey Sfumato glacier patterned dial with orange accents and blue luminescence. The case back is engraved with the “Spirit of Exploration” pattern and the watch is fitted with an interchangeable tapered stainless steel bracelet with a fine adjustment system.

products.name: 1858 Geosphere UltraBlack Limited Edition Mens Watch
products.description: The Montblanc 1858 watch series is inspired by the professional Minerva watches from the 1920s and 1930s which were conceived for military use and exploration. It combines a 42mm round shaped distressed stainless steel case and black leather strap with a traditional buckle. It has a black analogue dial with white luminescent rhodium-coated Arabic numerals and indexes, a date display, and two 24 hour sub-dials, all of which is protected beneath domed scratch resistant sapphire crystal glass with a double anti-reflective coating. Power is generated by the Calibre MB 29. 25 automatic movement with 26 jewels and a power reserve of up to 42 hours. This model also has a water resistance of up to 100 metres.

products.name: Orion 33 Rose
products.description: It may be blushing, but is by no means shy: This smaller Orion goes perfect with jewelry and is itself a wonderful adornment. With the light pink tone of the dial, a diameter of just 33 millimeters, and the light velour leather strap, this beautiful hand-wound timepiece from Glashütte is ideal for more delicate wrists.

products.name: Tangente 38
products.description: Based in Glashütte, Saxony, and established in 1990 by Roland Schwertner, Nomos Glashütte focus their efforts on producing manual-winding and automatic movements of the highest quality. Since 2005, NOMOS Glashutte has only used its in-house movements to ensure high-quality timekeeping and reliability. With a contemporary aesthetic and modern appeal, NOMOS Glashutte offer Luxury German works of art, at an affordable price. Tangente collection; this NOMOS Glashütte men's timepiece features a perfect 38mm stainless steel case with an elegant white dial, baton & Arabic numeral hour markers for enhanced legibility, and Sapphire crystal glass for additional protection. This timepiece is powered by a reliable mechanical movement and offers a 43-hour power reserve. The reliable and entirely classic manually-wound NOMOS Alpha caliber ticks inside visible through the sapphire crystal glass back. Finished with a sophisticated black leather strap and secured with a classic pin-buckle clasp. Water-resistant to 30 metres. Explore the full NOMOS Glashütte collection.

products.name: Ludwig Enamel 38mm Watch
products.description: Ludwig 38 has a new look, and yet remains classic—now with a glossy enamel-white dial. The movement within is a classic in its own right: Manual caliber DUW 4001 keeps on running, exactly as it always has.

products.name: Tetra Basalt 29.5mm Watch
products.description: This sophisticated timepiece in basalt black expresses elemental beauty with a purity of form. The dark, mineral tone is both grounding and striking, lending the square silhouette an aura of assured confidence. This watch reflects the personality of its wearer and the timeless allure of good design—powered by a mechanical caliber crafted to exacting standards by NOMOS Glashütte.

products.name: Tangente 2Date
products.description: Love at second glance too: This Tangente with a diameter of 37. 5 millimeters has two date displays in red that complement each other harmoniously. The exclusive NOMOS ring date—in a hand-wound watch for the first time here—shows the entire month; meanwhile, the large date window at 6 o'clock focuses on the current date. At midnight or when the quickset function is activated, the two displays set the white silver-plated dial with rhodium-plated hands in motion in a way that is doubly beautiful.

products.name: Minimatik Date Gold 39mm Watch
products.description: The art of allusion: With fine details in gold, this dress watch has the aura of a gold timepiece without losing its modern touch. The date window with its golden frame is an ode to every day. Modern and sleek, the delicate, slightly curved golden hands flow from the center of the dial to a round tip. Modern and harmonious, the design of this appealing watch is defined by precise forms. Inside, a hand-wound caliber made by NOMOS in Glashütte, Germany, ticks with high precision.

products.name: Metro 38 Datum
products.description: Generously proportioned, sophisticated, wonderfully beautiful—and a little larger than the multiple prize-winning original model: That is Metro 38 Datum. Without a power reserve indicator, this watch is even clearer, more paired down and, thanks to a growth spurt, a little more masculine too. This timepiece may be utterly cosmopolitan, but it also presents Glashütte watchmaking craft at its finest. A glance through the sapphire crystal glass back reveals the movement DUW 4101 with the NOMOS Glashutte swing system—the in-house escapement which helped the model Metro win appreciation and fan letters from around the world.

products.name: Club Sport Neomatik 34mm Watch Purple
products.description: In purple, Club Sport neomatik 34 appears somewhat more serious than the versions in gold and rosé, but it is no less versatile. Dark at first glance, but in a mysterious way not black, it goes perfectly with all berry tones. Easy to combine with a button-down shirt or a crewneck sweater, this is a sporty choice for the highest stylistic demands.

VERSATILE ENGINEERING Versatile in use, the Club Sport Neomatik is a dazzling adornment to the wrist of any man of today. products.description: This watch makes you happy. With subtle gold accents, namely the golden hands and hour markers, Orion neomatik doré presents its wearer with a genuine and lasting elegance. The elegantly slender automatic dress watch in a stainless steel case with a perfect lenticular shape represents luxury in its most elevated form. Masterful mechanics from NOMOS Glashütte in a perfectly minimalist design—with a small but decisive touch of extravagance.

Water-resistant to 30 metres. Explore the full NOMOS Glashütte collection.

products.name: Metro Date Power Reserve 37mm Unisex Watch Blue
products.description: Clear forms and precise functions: Metro date power reserve in ice blue captures the aesthetics of the modern city. The finely set minute track, where each minute is marked by a dot, along with the purposely blank space, lend the dial a distinctive clarity. In ice blue with its metallic finish, these design features are all the more striking. Inside, the new hand-wound caliber DUW 4701 – manufactured in-house by NOMOS in Glashütte – is at work. Smart, slender, mechanical: With a 37-millimeter diameter, Metro date power reserve commands more space on the wrist but remains exceptionally slender, despite its complications. It flatters the wrist and eye alike, suiting him and her.

products.name: Orion Neomatik 41 Date Midnight Blue
products.description: NOMOS Glashutte was founded in 1990 by Roland Schwertner just two months after the fall of the Berlin Wall. Specialising in manual-winding and automatic mechanical timepieces, NOMOS, since 2005 have only ever used in-house movements for assured reliability and precision. With a clean and modernist appeal, NOMOS provide luxury German masterpieces, at an affordable price. For a long time, Orion was only available with manual winding, since only a very thin movement would fit into its elegantly domed stainless steel case. Our neomatik calibers upgraded the watch to an automatic timepiece and a date function has made the still super-slender Orion grow to a diameter of 41 millimeters. And now it is also available in an elegant midnight blue.

products.name: Tangente Neomatik 38 Update
products.description: An automatic dress watch with an elegant date display. With the NOMOS ring date, the current day is displayed along the edge of the dial, framed by two color markers. It is intuitive to read, offers additional functionality by showing the entire month at a glance, and complements the clean face of the iconic NOMOS Tangente. Housed in a 38. 5-millimeter case, the patented technology behind the ring date fits many wrists.

products.name: Tangente Neomatik 38.5mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: The patented ring date in deep green – a invigorating yet calming color that makes the dial of Tangente neomatik Update, with its 38. 5-millimeter case diameter, truly distinctive. Green is a color that never feels too loud, and pairs perfectly with both formal and traditional styles. A sophisticated dress watch from an independent manufacturer.

products.name: Tangente Neomatik 41 Update
products.description: Based in Glashütte, Saxony, and established in 1990 by Roland Schwertner, Nomos Glashütte focus their efforts on producing manual-winding and automatic movements of the highest quality. Water-resistant to 30 metres. Explore the full NOMOS Glashütte collection.

products.name: Club Campus 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: This automatic watch is distinguished by a manufacturing movement. With its patented date mechanism, escapement specially developed and manufactured by NOMOS (a. k.a. the NOMOS-Swing-System) and, compared with similar calibers, having an exceptionally low height of just 3. 6 millimeters (which meets the highest standards of Glashütte watchmaking), excellent readability and the best material components. The robustness of the new Club Sport is emphasized by a sturdy metal band made of polished stainless steel with a satin finish.

products.name: Tangente Neomatik 41 Update Midnight Blue
products.description: The new date display is green: Tangente neomatik 41 Update is now also available with a midnight blue dial. The unique, patented NOMOS ring date with superluminova in green can be set quickly and easily—in both directions. This is thanks to in-house caliber DUW 6101 with automatic winding and a date mechanism that is also patented. A midnight blue masterpiece of straightforwardness: The clear lines and precise angles of the stainless steel case and the lugs, the completely flat sapphire crystal glass allow Tangente Update to remain as slender as ever on the wrist. High-precision playfulness for grown-ups: Here, the date has been redesigned. Have we already mentioned that it can be set quickly in both directions? It is very pleasing to the eye - whichever way you look at it. The entire month in view: The date ring set far out on the edge of the dial features two green markers that frame the current date. Today happens to be the 19th - also legible at night thanks to superluminova. Tangente Neomatik 41 Update is a tribute to form and engineering. The ring date gives the watch the look of an intricate measuring tool, the midnight blue dial adds an extra touch of elegance. Caliber DUW 6101: In all NOMOS calibers, the date ring is placed around the movement. In neomatik date, this caliber is particularly large. The first neomatik caliber with a date mechanism, it remains wonderfully slender. The date display can be made even clearer, and is particularly legible. Movement Height3.

products.name: Metro Neomatik 41 Update
products.description: Cosmopolitan, smart, with plenty of contemporary flair—that is Metro. As the version Metro neomatik 41 Update, this watch also loves clear forms. The unique, patented NOMOS ring date in neon orange is a sign of new times to come: The iconic design of Metro nevertheless remains unmistakably Metro. The new dark gray textile strap adds an extra touch of elegance to our latest creation made together with Mark Braun. Metro neomatik 41 Update remains beautifully slender even with a diameter of just under 41 millimeters: The stainless steel case with its fine, domed sapphire crystal glass and the striking wire lugs follow the form of the wrist in dynamic fashion. The techincal complexity is clear to see: The patented ring date can be set quickly and easily in both directions. This is thanks to in-house caliber DUW 6101 with automatic winding and a date mechanism that is also patented. Metro Neomatik 41 Update ticks to the beat of a fast-paced city lifestyle: The slender bezel sets the dial in motion, the design of the ring date is reminiscient of a series of small metro train carriages. If you want to make it in the city, there's no better watch to have on the wrist than Metro. Not just the minutes and the hours - Metro neomatik 41 Update also counts the days of the month. Two markers in neon orange frame the current date. Caliber DUW 6101: In all NOMOS calibers, the date ring is placed around the movement. In neomatik date, this caliber is particularly large. products.name: Club Sport Neomatik Worldtimer 40mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: With this watch, you have the world on your wrist—a practical feature for use at home or when traveling. One of the world's thinnest worldtimers, Club Sport neomatik Worldtimer blue shines with its deep blue dial, suitable even for formal occasions. It is also a fully-fledged sports watch: water resistant to 10 atm, robust, and with a luminescent time display for low-light conditions. The worldtime mechanism is easy to read and simple to operate, powered by the innovative DUW 3202 caliber at work inside.

products.name: Club Sport Neomatik Worldtimer 40mm Mens Watch Silver
products.description: Worldtime rethought: robust, radiant, clear, and elegant. The super-thin neomatik caliber DUW 3202 allows for a case height of less than 10 millimeters—making Club Sport neomatik one of the thinnest worldtimers yet. The time differences between the 24 time zones and the selected local time can be seen at a glance, the mechanism is easy to operate with a pusher at 2 o'clock, and the rhodium-plated dial with a sunburst finish is strikingly sporty.

products.name: Zurich Worldtimer 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: 24 watches in one: Zürich Worldtimer. Travel the world with the push of a button and automatically know the time in Sydney, Denver, Alaska, and New York. A complication that keeps things simple, which is also helpful even if you don’t leave the house—but are online, calling with friends in Honolulu.

products.name: Zurich Worldtimer Midnight Blue 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: Travel the world—and time itself—at the push of a button: With this elegant version of Zürich Worldtimer in midnight blue, traveling is so much more fun. This multilingual automatic watch knows the time almost everywhere, and will tell you the time in a click—in Rio or Hong Kong, Karachi or Dubai. A watch complication made simple.

products.name: Adventure White 37mm
products.description: Sleekly Determined The Adventurer range channels a sense of timeless utility for those who value substance and design. Compact yet expressive, it showcases Norqain’s heritage of high-precision Swiss watchmaking at its core. Refined Dimension Measuring 37mm across a polished stainless steel case, this piece offers an automatic movement and 100-metre water resistance. Its white dial, accented with baton markers, is complemented by a comfortable rubber strap for adaptive practicality.

products.name: Big Crown 80th Anniversary Edition 40mm Mens Watch
products.description: On the 80th anniversary of the Oris Big Crown Pointer Date, Oris is proud to present a special edition in bronze with a green dial. No watch tells the historic tale of independent Swiss watchmaker Oris quite like the iconic Big Crown Pointer Date. It’s a potent symbol of Oris’s philosophy, and some say that without it Oris might not enjoy its current status as a leader in Swiss Made mechanical watches. In 1938, Oris introduced a pioneering watch for pilots. It had an oversized crown so that glove-wearing airmen could easily adjust it, and an unusual complication – a date indicated by a central pointer hand. To mark the 80th anniversary of this landmark watch, Oris has created the Big Crown Pointer Date 80th Anniversary Edition, a special piece with a 40mm case, fluted bezel and oversized crown cast in bronze, and a striking green dial. Bronze patinates naturally as it oxidises, so that each watch will take on a unique finish over time. The deep green of the dial also has a natural feel, complementing the bronze case. Multi-piece bronze case with bronze screw-in security crown, dark brown leather strap made with sustainably sourced and produced materials, bronze buckle. Water Resistance 5 bar.

These complications serve the practical needs of the modern traveller whilst honouring the mechanical artistry that defines independent Swiss watchmaking. For those who value precision, independence, and timeless design, the Artelier Complication is a statement of personal conviction.

products.name: Aquis Dat Watt Limited Edition II 43.5mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: Introducing the Dat Watt Limited Edition IIWe’re delighted to announce that we’ve extended our collaboration with the Common Wadden Sea Secretariat to the end of 2025, and to present the Dat Watt Limited Edition II, a watch based on our Aquis diver’s watch that supports the conservation of one of the world’s most vital ecosystems. Salt and light The watch has a unique green dial, coloured to reflect the way light reflects off the salt marshes found in the Wadden Sea, an area that covers 11, 500 km2 in northern Europe. The watch also features an unusual circular date indication, driven by a Swiss made automatic mechanical movement. It’s water-resistant to 30 bar (300 metres) and comes with both a bracelet and an interchangeable rubber strap. Only 2, 009 pieces will be made, marking the year the Wadden Sea was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

products.name: Big Crown Pointer Date Calibre 403 40mm Mens Watch Red
products.description: The story of the Big Crown Pointer Date is the stuff of Oris legend. Its genesis began in the 1930s when Oris was a fast-growing independent company, known around the world for its precision wristwatches. The brief was to produce a watch that would serve a new clientele with very specific needs. For pilots, a watch would need to be as precise and reliable as any, but it would also need to be easy to use and read. Cockpits were uncomfortable places: cramped, hard, often cold, and always unforgiving. Oris’ solution was to produce a simple round watch in a stainless steel case, with a black dial and large Arabic numerals at 12, 3, and 9, and an oversized crown that could be gripped by a gloved aviator. It would also feature a date complication, indicated by a central hand with a red arrow tip. This way, it would be functional and legible, a toolwatch for one of the most demanding jobs imaginable. Little would its creators have known, but their practical, high-functioning watch of 1938 would become a design staple, one of the most recognizable watches in all of watchmaking. Today, almost 90 years since that first release, the Big Crown Pointer Date – as it’s become known – is our signature design and a Swiss watchmaking icon.

products.name: ProPilot X Calibre 400 Laser 39mm Mens Watch
products.description: Meet the new Pro Pilot X Calibre 400 Laser. Its 39mm case and bracelet are both in titanium, and it’s powered by our game-changing Calibre 400 five-day automatic. But the story this time is in its colourful dial, which is created using an innovative lasering technique never seen in watchmaking before. Incredibly, there’s not a drop of colour pigment in it. Instead, the blue, green and violet finish is created by reflected light. It’s a technological beauty. The technique behind the watch’s colourful dial is state-of-the-art. But it’s inspired by the principles of biomimicry, whereby technology reflects the wonders of nature. Think of the iridescent wings of a beetle and the way they reflect light to appear a bluey-green. It’s the same thing here. We developed the technique in partnership with Switzerland’s prestigious ETH Zürich university and this is the first time it’s been used in a watch. The result? Joy on the wrist.

In this delicate exercise of skeleton watchmaking, Parmigiani Fleurier's craftsmanship reaches new heights. The airy structure of steel and platinum, housing the intricately openworked PF777 manufacture movement, invites deep contemplation of its mechanics. The watch's clean and essential architecture, with its knurled and polished bezel and fluidly graphic bracelet, is celebrated by the most discerning horological purists.

The Milano Blue dial, detailed with a Guilloché Grain d'orge pattern, features rose gold indexes for superb readability. The rose gold crown includes a mechanism to realign the hands, making it easy to switch back to the original time zone. This fusion of functionality and elegant design renders it an exceptional timekeeping tool and a daily wearable piece of art.

products.name: Altiplano
products.description: Ultra-thin self-winding watch in rose gold. Black off-centre dial. Black alligator-skin strap. A mere 4. 30 mm in thickness, this automatic watch for men is one of the thinnest in the world. Its secret lies in the unique design of the rose gold case, whose case back serves as the plate to which 219 components are affixed. This complex structure fuses movement to case. Depending on an inverted construction of the calibre, with its bridges mounted on the dial side, it gives a result that is both technically and aesthetically effective. The whole mechanism and hand system is contained within the height of the balance, with an off-centre hours and minutes display. Within this extremely limited space, Piaget has designed a suspended barrel, held in place solely by a single bridge on the dial side, and a peripheral 22K gold rotor coated with black PVD.

products.name: Captain Cook Green Automatic Mens Watch
products.description: The Rado Captain Cook watch is perhaps one of the Swiss watch manufacturer’s most iconic models, and despite its release almost sixty years ago, it remains a resonating piece for watch lovers and aficionados alike today. With vintage details and styling true to the original, and up-to-date features that make it a match for modern wearers, Captain Cook is a watch designed to stand the test of time. The new 42 mm Captain Cook is water-resistant to 30 bar (300m) and has already proved a hit with contemporary watch wearers and modern explorers. The new Rado Captain Cook Automatic watch is brought to life in a new and improved form for the modern-day wearer with a polished stainless steel case, high-tech ceramic bezel and the Swiss watch manufacturer’s Easy Clip System which allows you to change the stainless steel bracelet quickly and easily without the need for any tools.

Presented in a 40. 1mm ceramic case, this Rado True watch features a sophisticated grey dial enhanced with glistening diamond dot hour markers, Rose Gold-tone hands, and a date display at 3 o’clock. Powered by a reliable automatic movement, this high-performance timepiece is water resistant to 50 metres and fastens with a ceramic bracelet. Discover the full Rado collection.

products.name: DiaStar Original Skeleton 38mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The Dia Star Original Skeleton features another variant of the high-quality R808 automatic calibre, anthracite-grey coated and complemented by various elements in its workings, for a lovely visual dance of contrasts. Thanks to sapphire crystal windows on both front and back, the automatic movement can be appreciated in full technical elegance, providing 80 hours of power reserve. An anti-magnetic Nivachron™ hairspring ensures that everything stays extremely precise and reliable, in a movement that has been tested in a full five positions. Its open structure, and the impressive R808 skeleton movement give a lighter, airier note to the new Dia Star Original, a perfect design counterpoint inside the visual frame created by the polished yellow gold coloured Ceramos™ bezel. The darker tone is further set off by floating yellow gold coloured indexes and hands with white Super-Lumi Nova®, for great readability even in low-light conditions.

products.name: DiaStar Original 38mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The unique Dia Star Original has a diameter of 38 mm and is water resistant down to 100 m. Framed by an ultra shiny yellow gold couloured Ceramos coiffe with polished angles and detailing set over a matching, yellow gold couloured PVD coated stainless steel case, this beautiful watch is rounded off with a parallel stripe faceted sapphire crystal. Specifications include a gold brushed dial with two directions, yellow gold coloured hands with white Super Lumi Nova, and a white day date display. The dial features eleven full cut diamonds, emphasised with the dark grey coloured printed jubilé logo. The Rado R764 automatic movement offers 80 hours of power reserve, with an antimagnetic Nivachron balance spring. The bracelet is made of yellow gold PVD coated polished and brushed stainless steel.

products.name: Integral Diamonds 31.5mm Ladies Watch
products.description: Since your taste is impeccable, you only ever wear the best, and choose the Rado Integral for precisely that reason. The slim, sleek case in polished stainless steel retains the Rado Integral’s signature square shape, its proportions aligned with the slightly tapered bracelet to enhance the aesthetic pleasure of the look. The case holds a curved and bevelled sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating and black metallization. The dial features a black lacquer finish beneath the traditional four Top Wesselton diamonds at cardinal hours, silvered Rado and jubilé logos and rhodium-plated hands. This iconic Rado design offers a large, easy-to-read dial and high-tech materials for maximum comfort. The Rado R218 quartz movement delivers reliable timekeeping that meets the Swiss standard for certified chronometers. With its cylindrical sapphire crystal and the luxurious feel of black high-tech ceramic links on the stainless steel bracelet, the Rado Integral is a perfect fit for your sense of high style. And you’ll note with pleasure the curved glass that aligns with the curve of your wrist, a sure sign of elegance, comfort and sophistication.

products.name: Centrix Moonphase 35mm Ladies Watch Black
products.description: Measuring the passage of time and the passage of the moon, the Rado Centrix Moonphase is a timeless addition to the Rado range. The earth, a black mother of pearl sky, a yellow gold coloured horizon and the moonphase complication mean the watch dial is a true work of art. A polished and applied moon really stands out on the dial. The look is completed by 12 Top Wesselton, VS-SI, diamonds. Black high-tech ceramic bracelet middle links sit against your skin, the watch is comfortable as well as durable. Yellow gold coloured accents complete the look, the watch is sure to standout. The Rado calibre R084 quartz, two hand movement with date and moonphase indicator, keeps the watch accurate and reliable.

products.name: Centrix Chronograph 41mm Unisex Watch
products.description: Experience the harmonious blend of artistic expression and refined design with the Centrix Chronograph. Crafted in stainless steel and treated to a yellow gold-coloured PVD coating, the 41 mm case is crowned with a curved sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating on both sides, ensuring impeccable readability. Beating at its heart, the Calibre R312 quartz chronograph sets a new standard of precision. Equipped with 22 jewels and a six-hand configuration, this movement integrates Precidrive and Heavydrive technologies to ensure unwavering accuracy of +/- 10 seconds per year. The black sunray dial, enhanced by yellow gold applied indexes with white Super Lumi Nova®, exudes refined sophistication. Three meticulously arranged counters include a 30-minute counter, a one tenth of a second tracker offering precise chronograph functionality, and a small seconds at 6 hour. The discreet date window at four o’clock adds a touch of practical elegance. The overall appearance of this iconic timepiece is completed with elegantly adjusted case lugs and a bracelet made of polished stainless steel treated to a yellow gold-coloured PVD coating with black high-tech ceramic middle links, secured by a triple-fold brushed stainless steel clasp.

products.name: Captain Cook Automatic 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook Automatic features a 42mm polished stainless steel case and crown. On top, a polished stainless steel rotating bezel with a polished blue high tech ceramic bezel insert with engraved numbers and markers in matt white Super Lumi Nova. Powering this watch is a Rado calibre R763, an automatic movement that delivers an impressive 80 hour power reserve. The rhodium coloured hour and minute hands are treated with white Super Lumi Nova and the tip of the central seconds hand is treated in yellow Super Lumi Nova, a playful nod to the colour of tennis balls. The Captain Cook Automatic watch is delivered with a stainless steel bracelet and a blue leather pouch. A pair of strap options is available including a classic blue leather strap or a blue and white NATO style textile strap.

products.name: Captain Cook Tennis Limited Edition 42mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook x Tennis Limited Edition blends Rados unmistakable signature with the world of professional tennis dynamic, stylish, and thoughtfully designed down to the last detail. Its 39 mm stainless steel case with a brushed high-tech ceramic bezel is water-resistant to 300 metres, while the refined stainless steel bracelet comes with three extra NATO straps that invite you to play with style: grass, hard court, clay each colour a tribute to the Grand Slam stage. Limited to 1985 pieces, this model is presented in a sleek grey leather case for those who combine sporty spirit with timeless luxury.

products.name: Captain Cook X European Cricket Special Edition 42mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Designed for European Cricket to mark Rado’s status as Official Timing Partner, this watch exudes pure athletic elegance. Playful design cues elevate the Captain Cook’s legendary sporting pedigree. Three golden dots channel cricket stumps, while subtle red touches pay tribute to the sport’s iconic red leather balls – the minute track resembles their stitching. Robust hands with Super-Lumi Nova® inserts make timekeeping effortless in all conditions. A scratch-resistant high-tech ceramic bezel insert and anti-reflective chevé-box shape sapphire crystal maximise performance. Its Rado calibre R763 automatic movement with 80-hour power reserve brings unbeatable reliability. Three strap options allow it to flex – in seconds with the Easy Clip System– from rugged to stylish or formal. A perfect blend of form and function.

products.name: Centrix 30.5mm Unisex Watch Brown
products.description: Famous the world over for its ground-breaking designs and use of pioneering materials, Rado is a Swiss brand with a wealth of history and expertise. Rado watches are instantly recognisable with their modern watch face designs and distinguished logo motif. Behind each face is years’ worth of visionary research and cutting-edge technology. Both men’s and women’s watches are available in the Rado collections – always with a focus on comfort, style and durability. Rado is known as the Master of Materials for the way it has revolutionised traditional watchmaking, leading the industry by introducing high-tech ceramic, ultra-light high-tech ceramic, colourful high-tech ceramic and Ceramos™ to its design-led collections. An award-winning designer with numerous prestigious international prizes to its name, and considered the most forward-thinking design player in the watch industry today, Rado has always been a pioneer and leader, setting the standard and raising the bar.

products.name: Captain Cook Over-Pole Limited Edition 39mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook Over-Pole is back! A stunning new Limited Edition reprises the key features of previous versions, in particular the R862 Worldtimer manual-winding movement. Robust, precise, and guaranteed to perform thanks to rigorous in-house testing in 5 separate positions, it is mounted within a bold 39 mm case. Côtes-de-Genève surface finishing, blued screws and gold-coloured details are easily admired through the sapphire crystal on the back. As sleek as it handsome, the new version comes with a stylish yellow gold PVD stainless steel bracelet with three-fold clasp. The bracelet is easily exchanged with a rugged brown leather strap thanks to Rado’s Easy-Clip system. In addition, the new Over-Pole comes with a practical leather pouch to store the watch and extra strap, and is accompanied by an official Limited Edition Certificate.
