products.name: LaCoupole Diamonds 31mm Ladies Watch Black
products.description: La Coupole stands as a tribute to the icons of yesterday, redefined for today’s sophisticated wearer. An expression of refined glamour, engineered with the precision and innovation only Rado can offer. Its 31 mm monobloc case in polished black high-tech ceramic is crowned by a domed sapphire crystal, elevated by a black & silver coloured metallised border. The case is water-resistant to 5 bar (50 metres), uniting everyday resilience with enduring elegance. The result is a silhouette that is unmistakably Rado—sleek, sculptural, and timeless. The black dial features wave-shaped markings filled with lacquer, creating an opulent three-dimensional effect. 11 Top Wesselton full-cut diamonds serve as hour markers, bringing quiet brilliance to the dial, while a date window at 6 o’clock offers refined functionality. At its heart beats the 8-jewel quartz Calibre R218, elevated by Preci Drive™ technology for exceptional precision. Securing the case, the bracelet crafted from polished black high-tech ceramic and enriched with decorative stainless-steel elements and clasp completes the design with seamless harmony. The La Coupole is an emblem of grace: designed to be desired and crafted to endure.

products.name: True Square Automatic Skeleton 38mm Unisex Watch
products.description: The Rado True Square Skeleton unites complex high-tech materials and ultra fine craftsmanship. Housed in a 38 mm matte plasma high-tech ceramic monobloc case, the R808 skeleton movement is equipped with 25 jewels and offers an 80-hour power reserve. Rigorously tested in five positions, it features an antimagnetic Nivachron™ hairspring and horizontal brushed decorations on the dial side, making this movement a pure demonstration of the Swiss legacy in high-precision engineering. Crowned by a flat sapphire crystal, the dial is a symphony of layered craftsmanship. The black sandblasted skeletonised top plate hovers above the lower plate. On this top layer, white Super Lumi Nova® indexes and meticulously printed white minute markers are precisely positioned, providing sharp legibility against the dark background. Beneath, the lower plate reveals refined horizontal brushed decoration in perfect harmony with the movement. At 4 o’clock, the iconic rotating rhodium-coloured anchor completes this dynamic and multi-dimensional display. Completing the case design is a plasma black high-tech ceramic bracelet, which flows seamlessly into a titanium 3-fold clasp, delivering the exceptional wearing comfort that high-tech ceramic provides.

products.name: Centrix Automatic Diamonds Open Heart 35mm
products.description: Experience the harmonious blend of artistic expression and design stylings with the Rado Centrix Open Heart watch. As the constellations write their eternal stories above our heads, they build bridges for lovers to meet. A large window, reminiscent at once of dawn and dusk, beautifully frames a state-of-the-art R734 automatic movement with 80 hours of power reserve and an antimagnetic Nivachron TM hairspring, as well as a deeply elegant rippled-sunlight "ondulé soleil" motif on chosen component surfaces. The overall appearance of this iconic timepiece is completed with adjusted case lugs and a bracelet made of polished rose-gold-coloured PVD-coated stainless steel with brown high-tech ceramic middle links. The dark brown mother-of-pearl dial with 12 diamonds, emphasised with the rose gold coloured printed “jubilé” logo, matches perfectly with the hands. The watch is water resistant down to 50 m and is also available in L size.

Whether you’re exploring new horizons or making a statement at a formal event, this watch is your perfect companion, representing timeless elegance and precision.

products.name: Captain Cook 43mm Mens
products.description: Charting new territory in vintage watches, the Rado Captain Cook is a natural choice for modern explorers. This automatic timepiece contains a mix of materials including high-tech ceramic and sapphire crystal, which is a style statement waiting to be discovered. Its vintage details, and up-to-date features make it the perfect watch for men and women. The Captain Cook is a watch designed to stand the test of time.

products.name: Captain Cook Chronograph 43mm
products.description: The Captain Cook Chronograph wears a characteristic box-shaped, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with anti-reflective treatment on both faces. The thin, stylish 43 mm stainless steel case features a polished blue high-tech ceramic inlay on the bezel, complementing the silver-to-blue gradient dial. The numbers, markers and triangles are treated with Super-Lumi Nova®. Inside, the new, thinner R801 automatic movement, with 37 jewels, five hands and 59 hours of power reserve thanks to an antimagnetic Nivachron™ hairspring, exceeds standard test requirements from 3 to 5 positions for higher accuracy. The model comes with a polished and brushed stainless steel bracelet, as well as a blue leather strap and an additional fabric strap in deep blue. products.name: Anatom Automatic Skeleton 32.5mm Unisex Watch
products.description: Since its debut in 1983, the Rado Anatom has stood as a symbol of groundbreaking design and ultimate comfort. Now, for the first time in Anatom history, a skeletonisation will allow us to glimpse within its core and admire its R808 automatic calibre. The dial has beautiful details of brushed bottom and upper plates, decorative elements, yellow gold hands, and white Super-Lumi Nova® indexes. At the same time, the Anatom signature feature remains: an anatomical shape that seamlessly fits around the wrist. The cylindrical sapphire crystal enhances the ergonomic shape of the watch, creating a smooth, continuous form that blends the case and bracelet together. Adjusted in five positions and equipped with an antimagnetic Nivachron™ hairspring, the Anatom Skeleton also delivers a high level of accuracy and an impressive 80-hour power reserve.

products.name: Rado Captain Cook High-Tech Ceramic 43mm Mens Watch
products.description: 2021: A year of hope and reinvention is the time chosen to reveal a timepiece without precedent, and that is here to revolutionise. The Captain Cook High-Tech Ceramic is the culmination of many years of research and development together with the history and tradition of the Rado Captain Cook. The further development of the Captain Cook collection in high-tech ceramic is Rado’s DNA in its purest form. It features some of the brand’s most stellar achievements such as Rado’s innovative high-tech ceramic monobloc case construction, scratch-resistant and hypoallergenic high-tech ceramic, powered by the premium Rado calibre R734 featuring a Nivachron™ hairspring. The innovative Nivachron™ hairspring provides an advantage in everyday life by protecting the timepiece from magnetic fields.

products.name: Captain Cook High-Tech Ceramic Skeleton 43mm Mens Watch
products.description: The Captain Cook High-Tech Ceramic Skeleton showcases its innovative R808 movement, a marvel of contrasts, know-how and clever geometry, that allows a distinct view of the various parts. It’s equipped with an anti-magnetic and highly reliable Nivachron TM hairspring that has been fully tested in five positions and provides up to 80 hours of power reserve. The superb matt-finish monobloc case is framed by a circular-brushed plasma high-tech ceramic bezel insert which matches the tones of the case and the outer bracelet links. Inside the rotatable bezel, a warm and bright rose-gold-coloured index ring adds contrast, next to the box-shaped sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating on both faces. The dial itself is intentionally spartan, with hands treated with white Super-Lumi Nova® to enhance readability in low-light conditions.

products.name: Anatom Automatic 32.5mm Unisex Watch Grey
products.description: Since its debut in 1983, the Rado Anatom has stood as a symbol of groundbreaking design and ultimate comfort. Its signature feature is the cylindrical metallised sapphire crystal with beveled edges on both sides, extending seamlessly into the plasma high-tech ceramic bracelet, creating a smooth, continuous form that merges the case and bracelet into a unified, cohesive shape. Crafted from polished plasma high-tech ceramic links and polished rose gold coloured PVD coated stainless steel middle links, the bracelet is meticulously secured by a brushed stainless steel 3-fold clasp. Beneath this distinctive crystal lies a grey lacquered dial revealing a striking pattern of irregularly spaced horizontal lines. Rose gold-coloured applied hands and indexes with coated white Super-Lumi Nova® create a refined contrast against the dial’s depth. Crowning the dial at 12 o’clock is the iconic moving anchor, complemented by a discreet date window positioned at 6 o’clock. Beating at its heart, and exalted through the sapphire crystal caseback, is the 21-jewels Automatic R766 calibre. Finely regulated in five positions and equipped with a Nivachron™ hairspring, this movement delivers a high level of accuracy and a robust 72-hour power reserve, underlining Rado's commitment to perfection.

products.name: Freelancer Date Classic Two-Tone Yellow Gold 40mm Cream Dial Mens Watch
products.description: Equipped with the RW4420 mechanical self-winding movement with a 41-hour power reserve, this freelancer timepiece combines technical precision with refined aesthetics. The captivating sunrayed cream dial creates a sophisticated depth and dynamic play of light. products.name: Freelancer 40mm Mens Watch Green
products.description: This evolution of the freelancer automatic collection is a new interpretation of the form watch, that elegantly transcends convention. This model has been reimagined for the modern individual, fusing a cushion-shaped design with signature brand details that radiate contemporary sophistication. Housed in a 40 x 40 mm square case with a green dial, this freelancer timepiece is equipped with an in-house movement of a 38 hours power reserve, the Calibre RW1212. The edges of the case softly arc, imbuing the initially modern design with a gentle aesthetic. The various facets, lines and curves play with light, accentuating the beauty of the stainless-steel housing. On the gradient dial, the Swiss-made automatic movement reveals itself through an open worked bridge. The Calibre RW1212 and the W-shaped oscillating weight, as a nod to the RAYMOND WEIL brand, can be admired through the exhibition caseback. Perfect balance of tradition and modernity, the freelancer automatic collection showcases RAYMOND WEIL’s unwavering dedication to craftsmanship and artistic expression. With a rich tradition of creative form watches for almost 50 years, RAYMOND WEIL has continuedly pushed the boundaries of design expression with collections such as Don Giovanni or Shine. Because breaking free from rules is in the brand’s DNA, these freelancer additions acknowledge this legacy of innovative design propositions while embracing the needs and desires of today’s discerning wearers.

products.description: Framed by a 42mm steel case, the freelancer Calibre RW1212 Skeleton is a two-handed model equipped with an in-house self-winding mechanical movement that beats to a frequency of 28, 800 vibrations per hour and features a 38-hour power reserve. RAYMOND WEIL presents the newest generation of our black freelancer skeleton. This best selling style has been ambitiously reinvented with a fully skeletonized dial – providing more transparency into the balance wheel at 6 o’clock and the manufacturing beauty contained within this timepiece. The black rubber strap offers modernity and urban style to this exclusive timepiece. The new stylish skeleton Calibre RW1212 is proof of the ever-evolving achievements of these in-house movements.

products.name: Freelancer Calibre RW 1212 Skeleton 40mm Mens Watch Anthracite
products.description: Framed by a 40mm stainless steel case, the freelancer Calibre RW1212 Skeleton is a two-handed model equipped with an in-house self-winding mechanical movement, the RW1212. The anthracite galvanic dial features a complete opening onto the skeleton movement, revealing its intricate architecture and the visible balance wheel at 6 o’clock. A black circular tachymeter scale adds a sporty touch, while shiny nickel-plated hands with white Super-Lumi Nova® ensure optimal readability. Fitted with a stainless steel bracelet and a folding clasp with double push-security system, the freelancer Calibre RW1212 Skeleton combines contemporary design, technical precision and everyday versatility. The sapphire crystal with dual-sided antiglare treatment and 100-metre water resistance complete this distinctive timepiece. Launched in 2007, the freelancer collection was created in honour of the free-spirited man who wishes to remain in control of his own destiny, and features an eclectic mix of urbane mechanical watches. Today, the freelancer Calibre RW1212 Skeleton continues this legacy, showcasing the Maison’s in-house RW1212 movement through a bold and contemporary skeleton design.

products.name: Seiko Astron GPS Solar Dual Time Chronograph Watch
products.description: Seiko Astron Watch GPS Solar Dual Time Chronograph SSH163J1. Astron GPS Solar 5X Dual-Time Chronograph in Celestial Grey. This Astron solar-powered timepiece is themed 'Solidity,' symbolising Seiko's innovative spirit which has been present since the brand's beginnings in 1881. Under a sapphire crystal glass, and within a compact and slim bezel design, is a grey dial with a vertical hairline finish. The increased charging capacity of this calibre allows for a textured dial whilst still maintaining high charging efficiency. The titanium case construction has a super hard coating for increased scratch resistance. The case is a compact and angular design that flows seamlessly from the bezel, through the lugs and to its bracelet. With sleek lines, this watch has a slim profile. Powered by the in-house built 5X83 solar GPS calibre, which inherits the same functions of the 5X53, but it has the added capability to measure elapsed time through its chronograph feature. The chronograph can measure elapsed time up to 1/20th of a second. It is accurate to ± 15 seconds per month whilst having a power reserve of 6 months at full charge and can be charged by any light source - either natural sunlight or artificial light - for convenience. Seiko Astron: the world's first GPS solar watch - powered by light, automatically adjusted to your exact time through the latest satellite technology.

products.name: Marinemaster 1968 Heritage Reinterpretation 42mm Mens Watch Black
products.description: Seiko Prospex ‘Marinemaster’ 1968 Heritage Reinterpretation in Satin Black In 1968, Seiko launched a revolutionary new innovation with the world’s first hi-beat Diver’s watch. With a case design inspired by the original 1968 piece, carrying the name ‘Marinemaster’ from Seiko’s heritage in diving watchmaking, this new re-interpretation has the same 300m water resistance. Under dual-curved sapphire crystal glass is a black dial has a satin-finished professional grade texture, purpose-designed to reduce light reflection for high contrast under water, optimised for diving conditions. A streamlined case, with the crown in the comfy 4 o’clock position, strong Lumibrite for legibility at the darkest depths and a unidirectional rotating bezel meet ISO Diving standards. This Air Diver features a ceramic insert bezel and a super-hard coating for increased scratch resistance. Especially crafted for diving watches, the 8L45 calibre is a highly accurate, reliable and robust movement. Crafted at the Shizukuishi Watch Studio in Japan’s Iwate prefecture, this calibre is accurate to +10/-5 seconds per day with a 72-hour power reserve. Prospex is a combination of the words ‘Professional’ and ‘Specifications.’ Seiko Prospex timepieces are designed to be practical, reliable and durable; to meet the high standards required in extreme environments for sports lovers and adventure seekers alike.

products.name: King Seiko VANAC 'Tokyo Midnight' 41mm Mens Watch
products.description: 'King Seiko VANAC 'Tokyo Midnight'In the 1960s, King Seiko timepieces led Seiko Watch Corporation’s developments in world-leading technical precision. ‘King Seiko’ originated when multiple Seiko watchmakers created different watches to encourage innovation – one of the Japanese watch brand’s constant aims. In 2025, the new King Seiko VANAC channels Seiko archive inspiration from the iconic 1970s collection of the same name. Since Tokyo was the birthplace of King Seiko, the design theme of the modern VANAC is centred around this world-renowned metropolis through ‘Tokyo Horizon;’ a series of watches expressing the city of Tokyo stretching out over the skyline. The deep midnight blue dial of this ‘Tokyo Midnight’ timepiece is inspired by the sky in the middle of the night over the Tokyo cityscape. The VANAC name is an acronym of its original design features: V for a 'Vibrant case design;’ A for 'Active lifestyle' – for both formal and informal occasions; N for 'Novel dial ring' – its angular edges resembling a metropolis cityscape; A for 'Alternative dial design' - a 3-dimensional dial design inspired by the horizon; C for 'Comfortable bracelet' - a short-pitch length bracelet, completed with a mirror and hairline finish. Powered by the new in-house built 8L45 mechanical calibre, it has been crafted with the highest accuracy of Seiko mechanical movements - accurate to +10/-5 seconds per day with a three-day power reserve. products.name: One & Two Dual Time Watches of Switzerland Group Limited Edition 42mm Pink
products.description: “From London to LV, via NY” Both, Speake-Marin and Watches of Switzerland have British roots. As these three cities are not in the same time zone, the logical decision was to go for a dual time. Salmon dial. The salmon dial is inspired by the desert surrounding Las Vegas, with its copper grain finish and superb light reflection. The Piccadilly case is the name of the historic case used since the Speake-Marin creation in 2002. The design is inspired by the famous Piccadilly Square in London. The hands. The heart shaped hands of Speake-Marin are directly inspired by the big ben tower clock hands. These products codes have always been part of the British DNA of Speake-Marin and will also be in the future. Limited to 10

products.name: Ripples Kármán Line 40.5mm Mens Watch Blue
products.description: Blue Sapphire. Thickness. Precision. The Ripples Kármán Line brings together everything that defines Speake Marin at its most technically ambitious: a sapphire crystal dial with blue metallisation, the iconic small seconds at 1: 30, and the ultra-thin La City case in 904L stainless steel. Look closer. The dial is not a surface, it is a statement. Crafted from sapphire crystal glass, its blue metallisation shifts with the light, its reverse side adorned with a sunray finish and Côtes de Genève motif that reveal themselves like a sky seen from altitude. The heart-shaped hour hand moves across rhodium-plated baton indices with quiet authority, while the minute flange, in blue PVD with an opal microbeaded finish, traces the outer limit of the dial like the boundary it is named after: the invisible threshold where Earth's atmosphere gives way to space, 100 kilometres above the surface. Beneath the sapphire crystal, the in-house SMA06 calibre beats at 5Hz, its 175 components held within a movement just 2. 5mm thin. The tungsten micro-rotor, decorated with an exclusive pattern of raised and recessed rectangles in alternating rhodium and blue PVD, is as quietly spectacular as the dial it serves. At 6. 30mm thick, the 40. 30mm La City case barely registers on the wrist. The integrated 904L steel bracelet, with micro-adjustment to the millimetre, completes a watch that leaves nothing unconsidered. The Ripples Kármán Line. Where watchmaking meets the edge of everything.

products.name: Pilot Big Date Flyback 42.5mm Mens Watch
products.description: Pilot Big Date Flyback – the sky is yours Presented in a 42. 5mm black ceramic case with an oversized crown Black corrugated dial Driven by the El Primero 3652 automatic high-frequency calibre movement 60-hour power reserve THE SKY IS YOURS Reminiscent of early pilot’s watches, the Zenith Pilot collection features retro elements with distinctly vintage styles that pay tribute to the brands long aeronautical traditions. From the early aviator models of the early 20th century, the range has evolved into the modern retelling we see today. TECHNICAL STYLE Take to the skies with this sleek and stylish 42. 5mm model, presented in a black ceramic case, complete with an oversized crown. The black corrugated dial is equipped with large luminescent Arabic numerals for enhanced visibility, and an oversized date display with a next-gen patented mechanism that advances and stabilises both of the timepiece’s wheels in under 0. 03 seconds. Powered by the El Primero 3652 automatic high-frequency calibre movement, the model is also equipped with a flyback function, which allows the chronograph to be reset to zero and restarted by a single push of a button, making it easy to operate even when wearing thick pilot’s gloves. ≤p>The watch is supplied with two interchangeable rubber straps – one black and one khaki. Featuring a 60-hour power reserve, the piece is water resistant up to 10 bar (100 metres).

products.name: Chronomaster Open 39.5mm
products.description: Offering a view of the beating heart of the El Primero Presented in a luxurious 39. 5mm 18K rose gold case Matte silver dial with tri-colour counters and a transparent counter Measures and displays elapsed time with 1/10th of a second precision Driven with precision by the iconic El Primero 3604 movement A GLIMPSE OF THE MOVEMENT WITHIN Bridging the past and present, the Chronomaster collection embodies the brand’s mastery of automatic, high frequency chronograph movement and the unique design language established over the course of 50 years. Beautifully presented within a 39. 5mm 18K rose gold case, the matte silver dial makes a bold statement with three counters - a 60-minute counter at 6 o’clock, 60-second counter at 3 o’clock, and transparent counter for the running seconds. Ensuring flawless precision, this confident timepiece is accurate to 1/10th of a second and offers a 60-hour power reserve. A blue calfskin leather strap complements the luscious rose gold tones of the case.
